### <a id="adminhtml"></a> `admin.html`
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>OmniDesk AI — Admin &amp; Agent Command Center (Window 2)</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Synchronized Live Ticket &amp; Takeover Console, Internal RAG Policy Studio, and Executive KPI Telemetry.">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/style.css?v=5.0">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
</head>
<body>

  <!-- =========================================================================
       INLINE ADMIN AUTHENTICATION GATE (No external redirect)
       ========================================================================= -->
  <div id="admin-auth-gate" class="modal-overlay is-hidden">
    <div class="modal-box admin-auth-box">
      <div class="modal-header admin-auth-header">
        <span><i class="fa-solid fa-lock text-cyan"></i> Authenticate Admin Console</span>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body">
        <p class="modal-description">Enter the administrator passcode to access live human takeover, RAG policy studio, and customer telemetry.</p>
        <form onsubmit="handleAdminLogin(event)">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="admin-passcode-input" class="form-label">Admin Passcode / API Key</label>
            <input type="password" id="admin-passcode-input" name="password" class="form-input" placeholder="admin-secret-key-2026" autocomplete="current-password" aria-label="Admin Passcode" title="Admin Passcode" required>
          </div>
          <div id="admin-auth-error" class="admin-auth-error"></div>
          <div class="admin-auth-actions">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" id="btn-admin-submit-login">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-unlock"></i> Authenticate &amp; Unlock
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="document.getElementById('admin-passcode-input').value='admin-secret-key-2026'; document.getElementById('btn-admin-submit-login').click();">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-key text-cyan"></i> Auto-Fill Default Key
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="app-layout">
    <!-- LEFT SIDEBAR -->
    <aside class="app-sidebar" id="app-sidebar" aria-label="Admin Navigation Sidebar">
      <a href="index.html" class="sidebar-brand">
        <div class="brand-icon-box brand-icon-admin">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-sliders"></i>
        </div>
        <span>OmniDesk<span class="brand-secondary-text">Admin</span></span>
      </a>

      <!-- Navigation Views List -->
      <ul class="sidebar-nav">
        <li>
          <button type="button" class="sidebar-item-btn active" id="btn-admin-nav-tickets" onclick="switchAdminView('tickets')">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-ticket"></i>
            <span>Live Tickets &amp; Takeover</span>
            <span class="sidebar-badge-count" id="admin-sidebar-ticket-count">0</span>
          </button>
        </li>
        <li>
          <button type="button" class="sidebar-item-btn" id="btn-admin-nav-rag" onclick="switchAdminView('rag')">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-book-bookmark"></i>
            <span>RAG Policy Manager</span>
          </button>
        </li>
        <li>
          <button type="button" class="sidebar-item-btn" id="btn-admin-nav-analytics" onclick="switchAdminView('analytics')">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-pie"></i>
            <span>Deflection &amp; CSAT</span>
          </button>
        </li>
        <li>
          <button type="button" class="sidebar-item-btn" id="btn-admin-nav-settings" onclick="switchAdminView('settings')">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-gears"></i>
            <span>Pipeline Settings</span>
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>

      <!-- Sidebar Footer -->
      <div class="sidebar-footer">
        <a href="app.html" target="_blank" class="sidebar-btn-ext" title="Open Window 1 (Customer Support Portal) in a new tab">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i>
          <span>Open Window 1 (Customer)</span>
        </a>

        <div class="backend-status-pill">
          <div>
            <span class="pulse-dot" id="admin-status-dot"></span>
            <span id="admin-status-text" class="status-text">Admin Connected</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="btn-icon" onclick="loadAllAdminData()" title="Refresh telemetry" aria-label="Refresh telemetry">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-right"></i>
          </button>
        </div>

        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="adminLogout()">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i> Lock Console
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- MAIN ADMIN WORKSPACE AREA -->
    <main class="app-main" aria-label="Admin Console Main Content">
      <!-- TOPBAR -->
      <header class="app-topbar" aria-label="Admin Topbar">
        <div class="topbar-title-wrap">
          <h1 class="topbar-view-title" id="admin-current-view-title">Live Tickets &amp; Agent Takeover Console</h1>
          <span class="topbar-badge topbar-badge-cyan">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i> Window 2: Command Center
          </span>
        </div>

        <div class="topbar-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="loadAdminTickets()" title="Refresh ticket list">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate-right"></i> Refresh Queue
          </button>
          <a href="app.html" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-external-link"></i> Launch Customer UI
          </a>
        </div>
      </header>

      <!-- TOP KPI TELEMETRY RIBBON -->
      <section class="kpi-telemetry-ribbon" id="kpi-ribbon">
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <span class="kpi-title">Total Tickets</span>
          <div class="kpi-val" id="kpi-total-tickets">--</div>
          <span class="telemetry-sub">All-time support tickets</span>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <span class="kpi-title">Open SLA Queue</span>
          <div class="kpi-val text-amber" id="kpi-open-tickets">--</div>
          <span class="telemetry-sub-amber"><i class="fa-solid fa-clock"></i> Active agent queue</span>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <span class="kpi-title">AI Resolution Rate</span>
          <div class="kpi-val text-emerald" id="kpi-deflection-rate">88.4%</div>
          <span class="telemetry-sub-emerald"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Policy deflected</span>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <span class="kpi-title">Average CSAT</span>
          <div class="kpi-val text-cyan" id="kpi-avg-csat">4.9 / 5.0</div>
          <span class="telemetry-sub-cyan"><i class="fa-solid fa-star"></i> Customer rating</span>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <span class="kpi-title">Policy Sections</span>
          <div class="kpi-val text-primary" id="kpi-indexed-sections">6 Chunks</div>
          <span class="telemetry-sub-purple"><i class="fa-solid fa-database"></i> ChromaDB Vectorized</span>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- =========================================================================
           VIEW 1: LIVE TICKET & TAKEOVER CONSOLE (Window 2 Core)
           ========================================================================= -->
      <div class="app-view-container active-view" id="admin-view-tickets">
        <!-- Filter Bar -->
        <div class="ticket-filter-bar">
          <div class="flex-row-gap-sm">
            <button type="button" class="chip-btn active" id="filter-all" onclick="filterAdminTickets('all', this)">All</button>
            <button type="button" class="chip-btn" id="filter-open" onclick="filterAdminTickets('Open', this)">Open</button>
            <button type="button" class="chip-btn" id="filter-inprogress" onclick="filterAdminTickets('In Progress', this)">In Progress</button>
            <button type="button" class="chip-btn" id="filter-resolved" onclick="filterAdminTickets('Resolved', this)">Resolved</button>
            <button type="button" class="chip-btn" id="filter-urgent" onclick="filterAdminTickets('Urgent', this)">High Priority</button>
          </div>
          <span class="text-dim-12" id="tickets-count-label">Showing tickets...</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Tickets Table Container -->
        <div class="admin-table-container">
          <table class="admin-data-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col" class="th-col-id">Ticket ID</th>
                <th scope="col" class="th-col-customer">Customer</th>
                <th scope="col">Subject &amp; Inquiry</th>
                <th scope="col" class="th-col-priority">Priority</th>
                <th scope="col" class="th-col-status">Status</th>
                <th scope="col" class="th-col-sla">SLA Countdown</th>
                <th scope="col" class="th-col-action">Action</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="admin-tickets-table-body">
              <tr>
                <td colspan="7" class="td-empty-state">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Loading live tickets...
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- =========================================================================
           VIEW 2: INTERNAL RAG POLICY MANAGER
           ========================================================================= -->
      <div class="app-view-container" id="admin-view-rag">
        <div class="rag-manager-workspace">
          <!-- Active Knowledge Base Overview Card -->
          <div class="rag-policy-editor-card">
            <div class="flex-between-center">
              <div>
                <h3 class="panel-heading-md">Active Knowledge Base (company_faq.txt)</h3>
                <span class="text-dim-12" id="rag-kb-path-label">Path: knowledge_base/company_faq.txt</span>
              </div>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="loadRagStatus()">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> Refresh Chunks
              </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Chunks Inspection List -->
            <div id="rag-chunks-list" class="rag-chunks-list">
              <!-- Populated via JS -->
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Hot-Reload & Upload Editor Card -->
          <div class="rag-policy-editor-card">
            <div class="flex-between-center">
              <div>
                <h3 class="panel-heading-md">Policy Studio &amp; Hot-Reload</h3>
                <span class="text-dim-12">Paste updated policy text or upload a markdown/txt file</span>
              </div>
              <label for="rag-file-upload-input" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm cursor-pointer">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-upload"></i> Upload File
              </label>
              <input type="file" id="rag-file-upload-input" class="is-hidden" accept=".txt,.md" onchange="handleRagFileUpload(event)" aria-label="Upload policy file" title="Upload policy file">
            </div>

            <textarea id="rag-policy-editor" class="rag-policy-textarea" placeholder="Paste policy markdown or numbered clauses here (e.g. 1. RETURN POLICY, 2. SHIPPING POLICY)..." aria-label="Policy markdown editor" title="Policy markdown editor"></textarea>

            <div class="flex-between-center">
              <span class="text-dim-12">Parses sections automatically on `^\d+\.\s+[A-Z]` boundaries</span>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-reindex-rag" onclick="uploadAndReindexPolicy()">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-bolt"></i> Re-Index in ChromaDB
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- =========================================================================
           VIEW 3: DEFLECTION & ANALYTICS
           ========================================================================= -->
      <div class="app-view-container" id="admin-view-analytics">
        <div class="audit-container">
          <div class="order-result-card">
            <h3 class="panel-heading-md">Query Audit Log Stream</h3>
            <p class="text-dim-125">Live audit trace showing customer queries, vector distance scores, matched clauses, and latency.</p>
            <div class="admin-table-container mt-10">
              <table class="admin-data-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">Timestamp</th>
                    <th scope="col">Customer Query</th>
                    <th scope="col">Status</th>
                    <th scope="col">Distance</th>
                    <th scope="col">Matched Section</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody id="audit-log-table-body">
                  <tr>
                    <td colspan="5" class="td-empty-state-sm">Loading audit logs...</td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- =========================================================================
           VIEW 4: PIPELINE SETTINGS
           ========================================================================= -->
      <div class="app-view-container" id="admin-view-settings">
        <div class="settings-container">
          <div class="order-result-card">
            <h3 class="panel-heading-md">RAG Pipeline &amp; Guardrail Configuration</h3>
            <div class="form-group mt-10">
              <label class="form-label">Distance Guardrail Threshold (Cosine Distance)</label>
              <input type="number" id="setting-distance" class="form-input" value="1.2" step="0.1" min="0.5" max="2.0" aria-label="Distance Guardrail Threshold" title="Distance Guardrail Threshold">
              <span class="text-dim-115">Values below threshold are considered grounded. Above triggers auto-escalation.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="form-group mt-10">
              <label class="form-label">Top-K Retrieved Chunks</label>
              <input type="number" id="setting-topk" class="form-input" value="2" min="1" max="6" aria-label="Top-K Retrieved Chunks" title="Top-K Retrieved Chunks">
            </div>
            <div class="flex-justify-end-mt12">
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="showToast('Settings saved successfully')">Save Settings</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- =========================================================================
       AGENT TAKEOVER DRAWER (Slide-Over Panel)
       ========================================================================= -->
  <aside class="takeover-drawer-overlay" id="agent-takeover-drawer" aria-label="Agent Takeover Drawer">
    <div class="drawer-header">
      <div class="drawer-header-left">

### <a id="archiveprojectpy"></a> `archive_project.py`
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
OmniDesk AI — Project Archiver & Bundler Utility

This script packages the complete OmniDesk AI codebase into:
1. A clean ZIP archive (`omni_desk_ai_archive.zip` / `project_archive.zip`)
   excluding virtual environments, git metadata, caches, and transient database files.
2. A consolidated single-file Markdown archive (`codebase_archive.md`)
   containing directory trees and complete source code for documentation and LLM analysis.
"""

import datetime
import os
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

# Base root of the project
ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# Default archive file names
ZIP_NAME = "project_archive.zip"
ALIAS_ZIP_NAME = "omni_desk_ai_archive.zip"
MARKDOWN_BUNDLE_NAME = "codebase_archive.md"

# Directories to exclude from archives
EXCLUDE_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "env",
    ".pytest_cache",
    "__pycache__",
    ".vscode",
    ".idea",
    "chroma_db",
    "node_modules",
    ".gemini",
}

# Specific files to exclude (e.g. sensitive local secrets or generated archives)
EXCLUDE_FILES = {
    ".env",
    ZIP_NAME,
    ALIAS_ZIP_NAME,
    MARKDOWN_BUNDLE_NAME,
}

# Specific file extensions to exclude from all archives
EXCLUDE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".pyc",
    ".pyo",
    ".pyd",
    ".zip",
    ".tar",
    ".gz",
    ".log",
}

# Binary extensions to exclude specifically from text/markdown bundle
EXCLUDE_TEXT_BUNDLE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".db",
    ".sqlite",
    ".sqlite3",
    ".bin",
}


def should_include_file(file_path: Path) -> bool:
    """Check if a file should be included in the project archive."""
    rel_path = file_path.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)
    
    # Check if any parent folder is in EXCLUDE_DIRS
    for part in rel_path.parts[:-1]:
        if part in EXCLUDE_DIRS or part.startswith("__pycache__"):
            return False
            
    # Check file name
    if rel_path.name in EXCLUDE_FILES:
        return False
        
    # Check extension
    return file_path.suffix.lower() not in EXCLUDE_EXTENSIONS


def collect_project_files():
    """Collect all valid project files relative to ROOT_DIR."""
    collected = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(ROOT_DIR):
        # Filter directories in-place to prevent os.walk from descending into them
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in EXCLUDE_DIRS and not d.startswith("__pycache__")]
        
        for f in files:
            file_path = Path(root) / f
            if should_include_file(file_path):
                collected.append(file_path)
                
    collected.sort(key=lambda p: str(p.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)).lower())
    return collected


def create_zip_archive(files, zip_path: Path):
    """Create a ZIP archive of the project files."""
    print(f"📦 Creating ZIP archive: {zip_path.name}...")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
        for file_path in files:
            rel_path = file_path.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)
            zipf.write(file_path, arcname=str(rel_path).replace("\\", "/"))
    
    size_kb = zip_path.stat().st_size / 1024
    print(f"✅ Created {zip_path.name} ({size_kb:.2f} KB, {len(files)} files)")


def generate_markdown_bundle(files, md_path: Path):
    """Generate a single consolidated Markdown archive file containing directory tree and all code."""
    print(f"📄 Creating single-file Markdown archive: {md_path.name}...")
    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    
    text_files = [f for f in files if f.suffix.lower() not in EXCLUDE_TEXT_BUNDLE_EXTENSIONS]
    
    lines = []
    lines.append("# OmniDesk AI — Complete Project Codebase Archive")
    lines.append(f"> Generated on: `{timestamp}` | Total Files: `{len(text_files)}` (Binary files excluded from text dump)\n")
    lines.append("## Table of Contents")
    for file_path in text_files:
        rel_str = str(file_path.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)).replace("\\", "/")
        anchor = rel_str.lower().replace("/", "").replace(".", "").replace("-", "").replace("_", "")
        lines.append(f"- [{rel_str}](#{anchor})")
    
    lines.append("\n---\n")
    
    for file_path in text_files:
        rel_str = str(file_path.relative_to(ROOT_DIR)).replace("\\", "/")
        anchor = rel_str.lower().replace("/", "").replace(".", "").replace("-", "").replace("_", "")
        suffix = file_path.suffix.lower()
        
        # Determine language for markdown block
        lang_map = {
            ".py": "python",
            ".html": "html",
            ".css": "css",
            ".js": "javascript",
            ".json": "json",
            ".md": "markdown",
            ".toml": "toml",
            ".txt": "text",
            ".yml": "yaml",
            ".yaml": "yaml",
            ".dockerignore": "dockerignore",
            ".gitignore": "gitignore",
        }
        lang = lang_map.get(suffix, "")
        
        lines.append(f"### <a id=\"{anchor}\"></a> `{rel_str}`")
        try:
            content = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            lines.append(f"```{lang}")
            lines.append(content)
            lines.append("```\n")
        except Exception as e:
            lines.append(f"*(Binary or unreadable file: {e})*\n")
            
    md_path.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    size_kb = md_path.stat().st_size / 1024
    print(f"✅ Created {md_path.name} ({size_kb:.2f} KB)")


def main():
    print("🚀 OmniDesk AI Archiver Initializing...")
    files = collect_project_files()
    print(f"Found {len(files)} project files to archive.")
    
    # 1. Create primary zip
    zip_dest = ROOT_DIR / ZIP_NAME
    create_zip_archive(files, zip_dest)
    
    # 2. Create alias named zip for convenience
    alias_dest = ROOT_DIR / ALIAS_ZIP_NAME
    create_zip_archive(files, alias_dest)
    
    # 3. Create consolidated markdown codebase archive
    md_dest = ROOT_DIR / MARKDOWN_BUNDLE_NAME
    generate_markdown_bundle(files, md_dest)
    
    print("\n🎉 All archive files created successfully!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

# OmniDesk AI (customer-assistant) — Senior Engineering Code Review & Audit

**Date:** October 5, 2026

## Executive Summary

OmniDesk AI is an enterprise customer service automation platform featuring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over corporate policies, server-sent event (SSE) token streaming, ticket escalation, multi-channel intent classification, and an AI agent copilot.

While the core functional concepts and RAG flows demonstrate clear product vision and rich UI styling, the codebase currently suffers from **critical security vulnerabilities** (including arbitrary file disclosure of `.env` and SQLite databases, hardcoded bypass credentials, unauthenticated PII access), **severe repository bloat** (committed binary ZIP archives, full duplicate repository clones, scraped web pages), **monolithic code architecture** (over 4,000 lines spread across 4 flat files), and an **incomplete testing and CI setup** where over half the test suite is bypassed by pytest.

This document details the complete architectural audit, categorized problems with code citations, gaps in professional software hygiene, and an actionable, prioritized improvement roadmap.

---

## 1. What the Project Does & Tech Stack

### 1.1 Functional Purpose
OmniDesk AI serves as an omni-channel customer support orchestration engine designed to deflect repetitive inquiries, enforce verified policy compliance, and assist human support agents.

Key capabilities include:
- **Zero-Hallucination Grounded RAG:** Ingests company documentation ([company_faq.txt](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/knowledge_base/company_faq.txt)) into a vector database and validates answers with distance guardrails to deflect unverified queries.
- **Real-Time Token Streaming:** Delivers SSE streams to customer clients via `/ask/stream` with citation attachments.
- **Smart Escalation & Ticket Lifecycle:** Creates tracked tickets (`TCK-XXXX`) with SLA urgency calculations, priority triage, and assignment workflows.
- **Agent Copilot & Response Macros:** Generates grounded suggested replies for support specialists with parameterized template macros.
- **Hybrid Retrieval (Dense + Sparse):** Combines dense vector retrieval with BM25 keyword scoring using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
- **Multi-Modal Vision Claim Inspection:** Assesses customer hardware damage photos and warranty claims.
- **Enterprise Operations:** Provides CSAT telemetry, synthetic benchmark testing, and outbound incident webhooks.

### 1.2 Technology Stack

| **Backend Framework** | [FastAPI](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py) (0.115.0+), [Uvicorn](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/main.py) (0.30.0+), [Starlette](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py) | High-performance async ASGI API framework |

## 3. Problems Identified

### 3.1 Critical Security Vulnerabilities

#### 1. Severe Information Disclosure via Static Root Mount
* **Location:** [server.py:1143-1147](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L1143-L1147)
* **Code:**
  ```python
  if os.path.exists("."):
      try:
          app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=".", html=True), name="static")
      except Exception:
          pass
  ```
* **Impact:** The entire project root is mounted publicly. Any remote client can send `GET /static/.env`, `GET /static/omnidesk.db`, or `GET /static/server.py` and directly download production API keys, the complete customer SQLite database, and server source code without authentication.

#### 2. Permanent Hardcoded Administrative Key Bypass
* **Location:** [server.py:112-115](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L112-L115)
* **Code:**
  ```python
  current_key = globals().get("ADMIN_API_KEY") or os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY", "admin-secret-key-2026").strip()
  valid_keys = {k for k in (current_key, os.getenv("ADMIN_API_KEY", "").strip(), "admin-secret-key-2026") if k}
  if token and token in valid_keys:
      return True
  ```
* **Impact:** The key `"admin-secret-key-2026"` is hardcoded into `valid_keys`. Even if a security administrator configures a 64-character high-entropy secret in `.env`, any attacker sending `X-API-Key: admin-secret-key-2026` will permanently bypass administrative authentication.

#### 3. Secrets Embedded in Client-Side Files & Database Seed
* **Locations:**
  - [database.py:835](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/database.py#L835): Seeds default admin password hash using `"admin-secret-key-2026"`.
  - [js/admin.js:10](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/js/admin.js#L10): Falls back to `'admin-secret-key-2026'`.
  - [admin.html:33, 38](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/admin.html#L33): Contains an autofill button that injects `"admin-secret-key-2026"`.
  - [admin-login.html:152, 189, 327, 431](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/admin-login.html#L152): Plaintext credentials displayed in UI.
  - [server.py:415](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L415): `/api/auth/developer-login` returns the active `admin_key` in plaintext in the JSON response.

#### 4. Unauthenticated Access to Customer PII & Internal Notes
* **Locations:**
  - `GET /api/tickets` ([server.py:574](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L574))
  - `GET /api/tickets/export` ([server.py:652](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L652))
  - `GET /api/tickets/{ticket_id}` ([server.py:725](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L725))
  - `POST /api/tickets/{ticket_id}/messages` ([server.py:778](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L778))
  - `PATCH /api/tickets/{ticket_id}` ([server.py:804](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L804))
* **Impact:** None of these endpoints require authentication. Any unauthenticated attacker can view all customer tickets, download full CSV database exports, read confidential agent notes, post fake messages, and close or reassign tickets.

#### 5. Broken CORS Security Configuration
* **Location:** [server.py:203-211](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L203-L211)
* **Code:**
  ```python
  app.add_middleware(
      CORSMiddleware,
      allow_origins=allowed_origins if allowed_origins else ["*"],
      allow_credentials=True,
      allow_methods=["*"],
      allow_headers=["*"],
  )
  ```
* **Impact:** Setting `allow_credentials=True` with wildcard `allow_origins=["*"]` violates CORS standards, creates cross-origin security risks, and triggers browser rejection in modern user agents.

---

### 3.2 Bad Structure & Architectural Flaws

#### 1. Flat "God Files" Architecture
* No modular Python packaging (`src/` or `app/` with `api/`, `core/`, `models/`, `services/`).
* Business logic, API routing, database queries, and HTML file serving are crammed into four massive files:
  - `server.py`: 1,153 lines
  - `rag_engine.py`: 1,059 lines
  - `app.py`: 981 lines
  - `database.py`: 845 lines
* Static CSS file ([css/style.css](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/css/style.css)) is a monolithic 4,600+ line stylesheet that is difficult to maintain.

#### 2. Dual Frontend Maintenance Overhead
* The project has two separate, competing frontends:
  - A Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS Single Page Application (`index.html`, `app.html`, `admin.html`).
  - A Streamlit Application (`app.py`, 981 lines) that reimplements the exact same customer chat, ticket list, and KB editor via HTTP calls.
* Maintaining two independent UI implementations introduces duplicate logic, inconsistent UI behavior, and doubled engineering overhead.

#### 3. Unsafe Mutable Global State in Multi-Threaded Server
* **Location:** [rag_engine.py:16-45, 82-98](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/rag_engine.py#L16-L45)
* Global settings dictionary `CURRENT_SETTINGS` is modified at runtime via `update_pipeline_settings()` using `global EMBEDDING_MODEL...` without thread locking. Concurrent requests in FastAPI will cause race conditions and corrupted runtime parameters.

#### 4. N+1 Database Query Performance Bottleneck
* **Location:** [database.py:284-311](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/database.py#L284-L311)
* `get_all_tickets()` executes `SELECT * FROM tickets;`, and then in a Python loop executes `SELECT * FROM ticket_messages WHERE ticket_id = ?;` for every ticket. For 1,000 tickets, this executes 1,001 SQL queries sequentially instead of a single SQL `JOIN` or grouped batch query.

#### 5. ID Collision Vulnerabilities via 4-Digit Random Numbers
* **Locations:**
  - `database.py:694`: `user_id = f"USER-{random.randint(1000, 9999)}"` (only 9,000 IDs)
  - `database.py:795`: `req_id = f"DEVREQ-{random.randint(100, 999)}"` (only 900 IDs)
  - `server.py:594`: `ticket_id = f"TCK-{random.randint(1050, 9999)}"`
* Random collisions on SQLite `PRIMARY KEY` trigger unhandled `sqlite3.IntegrityError`, causing sudden HTTP 500 crashes for users.

---

### 3.3 Duplicated Code & Repository Bloat

| Item | Problem | Impact |

| **`requirement.txt` & `requirements.txt`** | [requirement.txt](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/requirement.txt) and [requirements.txt](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/requirements.txt) are identical 210-byte duplicates. | Confusion on which file is authoritative. |

| **Hardcoded Keyword Dictionaries** | [rag_engine.py:100-113, 340-360, 370-380, 456-505](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/rag_engine.py#L456-L505) repeats identical keywords and hardcoded response strings across 4 separate functions. | Fragile, unmaintainable keyword matching logic. |

---

### 3.4 Missing Error Handling & Resilience

1. **Leaking Internal Stack Traces to Clients:**
   Multiple endpoints in `server.py` ([server.py:335, 512, 527, 864, 887, 1079, 1090](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L335)) catch exceptions and execute `raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))`. This exposes file paths, internal database details, and library tracebacks directly to external callers.
2. **Silent Failure Swallowing:**
   In [rag_engine.py:167-169](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/rag_engine.py#L167-L169), API errors during vector generation are caught with `except Exception as e: print(...)` and silently replaced with pseudo-random noise vectors. If an API key expires or is misconfigured, the system silently degrades without raising any alert or failing health checks.
3. **Unsafe SQLite Connection Handling:**
   Functions in `database.py` create connections via `conn = _get_connection()` without using Python context managers (`with conn:`) or `try...finally` blocks. If an unhandled exception occurs inside a query, the connection is never closed, leaking file handles.

---

### 3.5 Missing Input Validation

1. **Missing Email Format Validation:**
   [server.py:271, 292, 296, 300, 305](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L271) validates email fields using only string length (`min_length=3, max_length=120`). Strings like `"123"` or `"notanemail"` are accepted as valid customer emails. Pydantic's `EmailStr` is missing.
2. **Missing Enum Validation for Status and Priority:**
   Ticket priority and status fields accept arbitrary strings instead of strict Enums (`Open`, `In Progress`, `Resolved`; `Urgent`, `High`, `Medium`, `Low`).
3. **Pseudo-Vision Implementation:**
   In [rag_engine.py:1009-1024](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/rag_engine.py#L1009-L1024), `analyze_claim_image` determines warranty verdict solely based on substring search against `claim_description` before calling the vision model. The actual vision model output only populates `assessment_notes`, leaving the core approval decision driven by naive text keywords.
4. **Memory Exhaustion via Base64 Image Uploads:**
   `VisionClaimRequest.image_base64` accepts strings up to 7,000,000 characters without verifying image magic bytes or streaming to disk.

---

### 3.6 Unused Files & Packages

1. **Unused Node Package:**
   `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, and `node_modules/` contain `@sentdm/sentdm`. This package is not imported or referenced anywhere in any `.py`, `.js`, or `.html` file.
2. **Orphaned Root Database:**
   An SQLite database `omnidesk.db` sits in the project root while active code in `database.py` defaults to `data/omnidesk.db`.
3. **Missing Dockerfile:**
   A `.dockerignore` file exists in root, but there is no `Dockerfile` or `docker-compose.yml`.

## 4. What is Missing for a Professional Project

### 4.1 README.md
- **Status:** Comprehensive overview exists (328 lines), but contains critical inaccuracies:
  - Links to a `LICENSE` file that does not exist in the repository (dead link on badge).
  - References 8 phases of architecture, but fails to document environment variables, local setup instructions, or security prerequisites.

### 4.2 Automated Testing
- **Broken Discovery in Pytest:**
  - 4 test files (`test_rag_integration.py`, `test_ticket_escalation.py`, `test_production_hardening.py`, `test_phase4_features.py`) define test suites inside custom functions (`def run_all_tests()`, `def run_ticket_tests()`, `def run_phase4_tests()`) instead of standard `def test_*()` functions.
  - As a result, running `pytest` discovers only 19 test cases, completely ignoring more than 50% of the integration test suite.
- **Absence of Mocking & Long Execution Times:**
  - Tests do not mock external Google Gemini API calls. Running `pytest` took **1 minute 45 seconds (105s)** for just 19 tests because it makes live external API calls over the network.
  - If network access is unavailable, quota is exceeded, or the API key is not configured, the test suite hangs or fails.
- **Test State Pollution:**
  - Tests write directly to the active SQLite database (`data/omnidesk.db`), mutating production/development state and creating inter-test dependencies.

### 4.3 Linting, Formatting & Type Checking
- No linter or code formatter is installed or configured.
- `pyproject.toml` contains empty `[tool.ruff]` and `[tool.pyright]` sections with only exclusions and zero rules.
- Type annotations are incomplete across `server.py` and `database.py`.

### 4.4 Version Control & `.gitignore`
- `.gitignore` misses:
  - Binary ZIP archives (`*.zip`).
  - Markdown codebase bundles (`codebase_archive.md`).
  - Root SQLite database files (`omnidesk.db`).
  - Test coverage artifacts (`.coverage`, `htmlcov/`).

### 4.5 Environment Configuration (`.env.example`)
- `.env.example` is incomplete and out of date:
  - Missing `ADMIN_API_KEY` (defaults dangerously to `"admin-secret-key-2026"`).
  - Missing `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`.
  - Missing `DATA_DIR`.
  - Missing `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`.

### 4.6 License
- **Completely Missing:** There is no `LICENSE` or `LICENSE.md` file anywhere in the repository, despite the README displaying an `MIT License` badge.

### 4.7 Continuous Integration (CI)
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` contains severe anti-patterns:
  - Hardcodes `ADMIN_API_KEY: admin-secret-key-2026` in workflow YAML.
  - Uses `nohup python server.py > server.log 2>&1 & sleep 6` and `curl` instead of using FastAPI's in-process `TestClient`.
  - Executes `python test_master_suite.py` instead of `pytest` with coverage reporting.
  - Missing linting checks (Ruff), type checks (mypy), and security checks (Bandit / pip-audit).

### 4.8 Logging
- Python's standard `logging` module is completely unused.
- Over **150 raw `print()` statements** are scattered across the codebase.
- No log levels (`DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, `ERROR`), no structured JSON formatting, no request correlation IDs, and no log rotation sinks.

### 4.9 Architecture & API Documentation
- While `doc/` contains early design notes, there is no generated OpenAPI/Swagger export, developer onboarding guide, or database migration documentation (e.g. Alembic).

---

### Phase 1: Critical Security & Integrity (HIGH Priority — Immediate)
1. **Remove the Dangerous `/static` Root Mount:**
   - Remove `app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=".", html=True))` from [server.py](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L1145).
   - Only mount dedicated static asset folders (`/css` and `/js`).
2. **Eliminate All Hardcoded Admin Credentials:**
   - Remove `"admin-secret-key-2026"` from `valid_keys` in [server.py:113](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/server.py#L113). Require a non-empty `ADMIN_API_KEY` environment variable.
   - Remove hardcoded autofill buttons and hardcoded credentials from [admin.html](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/admin.html) and [admin-login.html](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/admin-login.html).
   - Stop returning `admin_key` in the response of `/api/auth/developer-login`.
3. **Lock Down Customer Endpoints with Proper Authentication:**
   - Add authentication dependencies to `GET /api/tickets`, `GET /api/tickets/export`, `PATCH /api/tickets/{ticket_id}`, and message endpoints.
   - Restrict customer queries to their own authenticated customer session or ticket verification token.
4. **Fix CORS Configuration:**
   - Specify explicit trusted domains or disallow credential passing when using wildcard origins.
5. **Sanitize Exception Responses:**
   - Replace `raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))` with generic error messages (`"An internal server error occurred"`) and log full stack traces internally.
6. **Purge Repository Bloat:**
   - Remove [customer-agent-temp/](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/customer-agent-temp), [omni_desk_ai_archive.zip](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/omni_desk_ai_archive.zip), [project_archive.zip](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/project_archive.zip), [codebase_archive.md](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/codebase_archive.md), and scraped markdown files from git tracking.
   - Consolidate duplicate prototype folders in root vs `stitch_customer_assistant_ui_redesign/`.
   - Delete duplicate [requirement.txt](file:///c:/Users/kastu/Desktop/mahesh%20pro/requirement.txt) and unused `package.json` / `node_modules/`.

---

### Phase 2: Architecture & Testing Refactor (MEDIUM Priority)
1. **Refactor Test Suite for 100% Pytest Discovery:**
   - Rename custom test runners (`run_all_tests()`, `run_ticket_tests()`, `run_phase4_tests()`) in `test_rag_integration.py`, `test_ticket_escalation.py`, `test_production_hardening.py`, and `test_phase4_features.py` into standard `def test_*()` pytest functions.
   - Move all test files into a dedicated `tests/` directory.
2. **Implement Mocking for Fast, Deterministic Unit Tests:**
   - Create pytest fixtures to mock `google.genai.Client` and embedding generation so tests run offline in <5 seconds without incurring API costs or network timeouts.
   - Use an isolated temporary SQLite database (`sqlite3.connect(":memory:")` or `tmp_path`) for test executions.
3. **Modularize Application Architecture (`src/` Layout):**
   - Split `server.py` into modular FastAPI routers (`api/routers/tickets.py`, `api/routers/rag.py`, `api/routers/auth.py`, `api/routers/admin.py`).
   - Extract Pydantic schemas into `schemas/` and core configuration into `core/config.py` using `pydantic-settings`.
   - Refactor `database.py` queries to eliminate N+1 queries using SQL `JOIN` statements, and wrap all database operations in connection context managers (`with _get_connection() as conn:`).
4. **Replace Unsafe 4-Digit Random IDs:**
   - Replace `random.randint(1000, 9999)` with UUID4 (`uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]`) or cryptographic tokens to prevent primary key collisions.
5. **Implement Enterprise Structured Logging:**
   - Replace all `print()` statements with Python's standard `logging` module configured with log levels, timestamps, and request context.

---

### Phase 3: Code Quality, DevOps & Hygiene (LOW Priority / Polish)
1. **Add LICENSE File:**
   - Add standard MIT `LICENSE` file matching the badge in `README.md`.
2. **Update `.env.example`:**
   - Document all configuration keys: `ADMIN_API_KEY`, `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`, `DATA_DIR`, `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
3. **Configure Tooling in `pyproject.toml`:**
   - Configure Ruff for linting and formatting (`select = ["E", "F", "I", "W"]`, `line-length = 100`).
   - Configure mypy for type checking.
4. **Modernize GitHub Actions CI Pipeline:**
   - Run `ruff check` and `mypy` in CI.
   - Replace the `nohup uvicorn & sleep 6` script with `pytest --cov=src tests/`.
5. **Provide Production Containerization:**
   - Add a multi-stage production `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml` defining both the backend API and optional reverse proxy.
6. **Unify Frontend Strategy:**
   - Clearly designate the primary interface (the Vanilla SPA) and deprecate or package the Streamlit app (`app.py`) as an optional dev tool.

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   OMNIDESK AI — MASTER ENTERPRISE DESIGN SYSTEM (style.css)
   Desktop-First Two-Window Architecture
   Colorway: Obsidian (#0b0f19), Midnight Slate (#111827, #1f2937), Indigo Accent (#6366f1)
   Typography: Inter + Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono
   ========================================================================== */

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

:root {
  /* Color Canvas */
  --bg-canvas: #0b0f19;
  --bg-surface: #111827;
  --bg-surface-elevated: #161f36;
  --bg-surface-card: #141c30;
  --bg-surface-hover: #1e293b;
  --bg-input: #0e1424;

  /* Primary Brand Accents */
  --primary: #6366f1;
  --primary-hover: #4f46e5;
  --primary-light: #818cf8;
  --primary-glow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25);
  --primary-border: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);

  /* Status Accents */
  --accent-cyan: #06b6d4;
  --accent-cyan-glow: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2);
  --accent-emerald: #10b981;
  --accent-emerald-glow: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
  --accent-amber: #f59e0b;
  --accent-amber-glow: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
  --accent-rose: #ef4444;
  --accent-rose-glow: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);

  /* Typography Colors */
  --text-main: #f8fafc;
  --text-muted: #94a3b8;
  --text-dim: #64748b;
  --text-white: #ffffff;

  /* Crisp Borders */
  --border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --border-medium: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --border-highlight: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);

  /* Fonts */
  --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

  /* Radii */
  --radius-xs: 4px;
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-card: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-subtle);
  --shadow-elevated: 0 10px 30px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-medium);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 25px var(--primary-glow);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   RESET & BASE
   ========================================================================== */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html, body {
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

button, input, select, textarea {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  border: none;
  background: none;
  outline: none;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}

ul, ol {
  list-style: none;
}

/* Custom Sleek Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}

/* Utilities */
.is-hidden { display: none !important; }
.text-primary { color: var(--primary) !important; }
.text-cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan) !important; }
.text-emerald { color: var(--accent-emerald) !important; }
.text-amber { color: var(--accent-amber) !important; }
.text-rose { color: var(--accent-rose) !important; }

/* ==========================================================================

/* Chat Composer Area */
.chat-composer-area {
  padding: 16px 20px 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

.composer-box {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.composer-box:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--primary);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary);
}

.composer-textarea {
  flex: 1;
  max-height: 140px;
  min-height: 24px;
  resize: none;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text-main);
  background: transparent;
}

.composer-footer-row {
  margin-top: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.btn-text-link {
  color: var(--primary-light);
  font-weight: 500;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}
.btn-text-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  color: #fff;
}

/* Live Agent Escalation Banner */
.escalation-active-banner {
  margin: 12px 20px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-cyan);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  animation: pulseCyan 2s infinite ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes pulseCyan {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(6, 182, 212, 0); }
}

/* Chat Right Pane: Policy Inspector & Citations */
.chat-right-pane {
  width: 320px;
  min-width: 320px;
  max-width: 320px;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
}

.right-pane-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.pane-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-main);
}

.pane-card-subtitle {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.sources-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.source-item-card {
  padding: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.source-item-card h4 {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-emerald);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   WINDOW 1: ORDER LOOKUP PANEL (view-orders)
   ========================================================================== */
.order-lookup-workspace {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.order-search-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 8px 12px;
}

.order-search-bar input {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-main);
}

.order-sample-chips {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.order-result-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.order-header-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding-bottom: 14px;
}

.order-id-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-main);
}

.status-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.badge-shipped { background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15); color: var(--accent-cyan); border: 1px solid var(--accent-cyan); }
.badge-delivered { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-emerald); border: 1px solid var(--accent-emerald); }
.badge-processing { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: var(--accent-amber); border: 1px solid var(--accent-amber); }

/* ==========================================================================
   WINDOW 1: VISUAL CLAIM INSPECTION (view-claim)
   ========================================================================== */
.claim-workspace {
  max-width: 860px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.drop-zone-card {
  border: 2px dashed var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 36px 20px;
  text-align: center;
  background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.5);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.drop-zone-card:hover, .drop-zone-card.drag-over {
  border-color: var(--primary);
  background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05);
}

.drop-icon {
  font-size: 38px;
  color: var(--primary-light);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.diagnosis-result-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--primary-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--primary-glow);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   WINDOW 2: ADMIN & AGENT COMMAND CENTER (admin.html)
   ========================================================================== */

/* Top KPI Telemetry Ribbon */
.kpi-telemetry-ribbon {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

.kpi-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.kpi-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--border-medium);
}

.kpi-title {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.kpi-val {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-main);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

/* Live Ticket Table */
.admin-table-container {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.admin-data-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.admin-data-table th {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.admin-data-table td {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  color: var(--text-main);
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.admin-data-table tbody tr {
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.admin-data-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface-hover);
}

.admin-data-table tbody tr.row-selected {
  background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--primary);
}

/* Priority Badges */
.priority-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.priority-urgent { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: var(--accent-rose); border: 1px solid var(--accent-rose); }
.priority-high { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: var(--accent-amber); border: 1px solid var(--accent-amber); }
.priority-medium { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15); color: var(--primary-light); border: 1px solid var(--primary); }
.priority-low { background: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.15); color: var(--text-muted); border: 1px solid var(--border-medium); }

/* Agent Takeover Drawer (Split View or Slide-Over) */
.takeover-drawer-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 540px;
  height: 100vh;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  box-shadow: -10px 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  z-index: 100;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.takeover-drawer-overlay.is-open {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.drawer-header {
  height: 64px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}

.drawer-body {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.drawer-thread-scroll {
  flex: 1;
  max-height: 380px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.drawer-reply-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

/* RAG Policy Manager */
.rag-manager-workspace {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
  flex: 1;
}

.rag-policy-editor-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.rag-policy-textarea {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 340px;
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 12px;
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  resize: vertical;
}

/* MODALS */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 200;
}

.modal-box {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 500px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevated);
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: modalPop 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

@keyframes modalPop {
  from { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}

.modal-header {
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.modal-body {
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.form-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.form-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.form-input, .form-select, .form-textarea {
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-size: 13.5px;
}

.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--primary);
}

/* Toast */
.toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  right: 24px;
  z-index: 999;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.toast {
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 13px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  animation: slideInRight 0.2s ease;
}

@keyframes slideInRight {
  from { transform: translateX(30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
}


/* ==========================================================================
   SEMANTIC UTILITY & COMPONENT CLASSES (Separation of Concerns)
   ========================================================================== */
.cursor-pointer {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.flex-1 {
  flex: 1;
}

.text-right {
  text-align: right;
}

.flex-between-center {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.flex-justify-end {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.flex-row-gap-sm {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.flex-row-gap-sm-align-center {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
}

.mt-6 {
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.mt-10 {
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.flex-justify-end-mt12 {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.text-dim-115 {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.text-dim-12 {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.text-dim-125 {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.panel-heading-md {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Customer Portal (Window 1) Specific */
.sync-indicator-badge {
  display: none;
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15);
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.pulse-dot-cyan {
  background: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.quick-service-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.btn-start {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.view-header-block {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.view-title-lg {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.view-subtitle-sm {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.search-input-icon {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  align-self: center;
}

.order-meta-text {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.order-items-label {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.order-items-text {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}

.order-footer-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding-top: 12px;
}

.tracking-num-label {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.tracking-num-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.order-price-val {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
}

.cust-ticket-details-box {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.cust-ticket-display-subject {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.ticket-conv-title {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.cust-ticket-messages-stream {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  max-height: 280px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

.cust-reply-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.claim-drop-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.claim-drop-subtitle {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 12.5px;
}

.claim-preview-container {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 12px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}

.claim-preview-img {
  width: 70px;
  height: 70px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
}

.claim-preview-filename {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.claim-preview-status {
  color: var(--accent-emerald);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.claim-diagnosis-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
}

.diagnosis-text-content {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--text-main);
}

.claim-footer-row {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding-top: 14px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.claim-warranty-tag {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 12.5px;
}

.modal-description {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.modal-actions-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

/* Admin Console (Window 2) Specific */
.admin-auth-box {
  max-width: 420px;
  border-color: var(--primary-border);
}

.admin-auth-header {
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}

.admin-auth-error {
  color: var(--accent-rose);
  font-size: 12px;
  display: none;
}

.admin-auth-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.topbar-badge-cyan {
  background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.12);
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);
}

.telemetry-sub {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.telemetry-sub-amber {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent-amber);
}

.telemetry-sub-emerald {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent-emerald);
}

.telemetry-sub-cyan {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
}

.telemetry-sub-purple {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--primary-light);
}

.ticket-filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.th-col-id { width: 110px; }
.th-col-customer { width: 170px; }
.th-col-priority { width: 100px; }
.th-col-status { width: 120px; }
.th-col-sla { width: 150px; }
.th-col-action { width: 120px; text-align: right; }

.td-empty-state {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 30px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.td-empty-state-sm {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 20px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.rag-chunks-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  max-height: 450px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-right: 4px;
}

.audit-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}

.settings-container {
  max-width: 700px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.drawer-header-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.drawer-customer-card {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-canvas);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.drawer-customer-name {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-main);
}

.drawer-customer-email {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.drawer-sla-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent-cyan);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

### <a id="databasepy"></a> `database.py`
```python
"""
OmniDesk AI — SQLite Persistence Layer
Replaces volatile in-memory databases with persistent, thread-safe SQLite storage.
Manages:
1. Tickets & Lifecycle States (Open, In Progress, Resolved)
2. Ticket Message Threads & Private Staff Notes
3. Customer CSAT Feedback & Ratings
4. Query Audit Logs
5. Outbound Webhook Alert Logs
"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import random
import re
import secrets
import sqlite3
import time
from typing import Any

DB_DIR = os.getenv("DATA_DIR", "data")
DB_PATH = os.path.join(DB_DIR, "omnidesk.db")

def _get_connection() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Creates a thread-safe connection with row_factory set to dict-like sqlite3.Row."""
    os.makedirs(DB_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH, check_same_thread=False, timeout=60.0)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 60000;") # 60 seconds busy wait
    conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")
    return conn

def init_db():
    """Initializes the database schema and populates initial demo seed data if empty."""
    conn = _get_connection()
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;")
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # 1. Tickets Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        customer_email TEXT NOT NULL,
        customer_tier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Standard Retail',
        intent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'General Inquiry',
        sentiment TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Standard',
        subject TEXT NOT NULL,
        query TEXT NOT NULL,
        priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Medium',
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Open',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_ts REAL NOT NULL,
        assigned_agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Unassigned',
        transcript_snippet TEXT
    );
    """)

    # 2. Ticket Messages & Internal Notes Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ticket_messages (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        ticket_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        sender TEXT NOT NULL,
        text TEXT NOT NULL,
        is_internal_note INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES tickets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    """)

    # 3. Customer CSAT Feedback Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feedback (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        query TEXT NOT NULL,
        rating INTEGER NOT NULL,
        is_positive INTEGER NOT NULL,
        comment TEXT,
        language TEXT DEFAULT 'English',
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    # 4. Audit Logs Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        query TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        distance REAL,
        matched TEXT,
        latency_ms INTEGER,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    # 5. Outbound Webhook Logs Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_logs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
        destination TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'delivered',
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    # 6. UX & System Feature Flags Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS features (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    # 7. Customer & Developer Users Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        salt TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'customer',
        tier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Standard Retail',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    # 8. User Auth Sessions Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
        token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    """)

    # 9. Developer Key Requests Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS developer_key_requests (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        email TEXT NOT NULL,
        team TEXT NOT NULL,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    # 10. Orders Table
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        customer_email TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        items TEXT NOT NULL,
        tracking_number TEXT,
        total TEXT NOT NULL,
        order_date TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """)

    conn.commit()

    # Seed initial data if tickets table is empty
    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tickets;")
    count = cursor.fetchone()["count"]
    if count == 0:
        _seed_initial_data(conn)

    # Seed initial demo users if users table is empty
    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM users;")
    u_count = cursor.fetchone()["count"]
    if u_count == 0:
        _seed_initial_users(conn)

    # Seed initial orders if orders table is empty
    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM orders;")
    o_count = cursor.fetchone()["count"]
    if o_count == 0:
        _seed_initial_orders(conn)
    else:
        # Idempotent migration: ensure ORD-1002 has updated status and tracking number
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE orders
        SET status = 'Shipped', tracking_number = '1Z999AA10123456784'
        WHERE id = 'ORD-1002';
        """)
        conn.commit()

    conn.close()

def _seed_initial_orders(conn: sqlite3.Connection):
    """Seeds default customer orders."""
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.executemany("""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO orders (id, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, status, items, tracking_number, total, order_date)
