### <a id="jsadminjs"></a> `js/admin.js`
```javascript
/* ==========================================================================
   OMNIDESK AI — ADMIN & AGENT COMMAND CENTER CONTROLLER (admin.js)
   Synchronized Desktop-First Two-Window UI (Window 2)
   Features: Inline Auth Gate, Top KPI Ribbon, Live Ticket Table,
   Agent Takeover Drawer with Copilot/Macros, Internal RAG Policy Studio.
   ========================================================================== */

const AdminState = {
  currentView: 'tickets',
  backendUrl: window.location.origin.startsWith('http') && !window.location.port.match(/^(5500|3000|5173)$/)
    ? window.location.origin
    : 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
  apiKey: localStorage.getItem('omni_admin_key') || 'admin-secret-key-2026',
  token: localStorage.getItem('omni_admin_token') || '',
  isAuthenticated: false,
  activeFilter: 'all',
  tickets: [],
  selectedTicket: null,
  pollTimer: null
};

// ==========================================================================
// INITIALIZATION
// ==========================================================================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
  checkExistingAuth();
  if (AdminState.isAuthenticated) {
    await loadAllAdminData();
    startAdminAutoRefresh();
  }
});

// Authentication Gate Check
function checkExistingAuth() {
  const savedToken = localStorage.getItem('omni_admin_token');
  const savedKey = localStorage.getItem('omni_admin_key');
  const authGate = document.getElementById('admin-auth-gate');

  if (savedToken || savedKey) {
    AdminState.token = savedToken || savedKey;
    AdminState.isAuthenticated = true;
    if (authGate) authGate.classList.add('is-hidden');
  } else {
    // Show inline modal gate — NEVER redirect to admin-login.html
    AdminState.isAuthenticated = false;
    if (authGate) authGate.classList.remove('is-hidden');
  }
}

async function handleAdminLogin(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const input = document.getElementById('admin-passcode-input');
  const errorEl = document.getElementById('admin-auth-error');
  const passcode = input.value.trim();
  if (!passcode) return;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/admin/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ password: passcode })
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error('Invalid administrator passcode. Please try again.');
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const token = data.token || data.access_token || passcode;
    AdminState.token = token;
    AdminState.apiKey = token;
    AdminState.isAuthenticated = true;
    localStorage.setItem('omni_admin_token', token);
    localStorage.setItem('omni_admin_key', token);

    const authGate = document.getElementById('admin-auth-gate');
    if (authGate) authGate.classList.add('is-hidden');
    if (errorEl) errorEl.style.display = 'none';

    await loadAllAdminData();
    startAdminAutoRefresh();
    showToast('Admin Console Authenticated');
  } catch (err) {
    if (errorEl) {
      errorEl.textContent = err.message;
      errorEl.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }
}

function adminLogout() {
  localStorage.removeItem('omni_admin_token');
  localStorage.removeItem('omni_admin_key');
  AdminState.isAuthenticated = false;
  if (AdminState.pollTimer) clearInterval(AdminState.pollTimer);

  const authGate = document.getElementById('admin-auth-gate');
  if (authGate) authGate.classList.remove('is-hidden');
  showToast('Admin Console Locked');
}

function getAuthHeaders() {
  const h = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (AdminState.token) {
    h['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${AdminState.token}`;
    h['X-API-Key'] = AdminState.token;
  }
  return h;
}

// Master Data Loader
async function loadAllAdminData() {
  await Promise.all([
    loadTelemetry(),
    loadAdminTickets(),
    loadRagStatus(),
    loadAuditLogs()
  ]);
}

function startAdminAutoRefresh() {
  if (AdminState.pollTimer) clearInterval(AdminState.pollTimer);
  AdminState.pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
    if (AdminState.isAuthenticated) {
      loadTelemetry(true);
      loadAdminTickets(true);
    }
  }, 4000);
}

// ==========================================================================
// NAVIGATION CONTROLLER
// ==========================================================================
function switchAdminView(viewName) {
  AdminState.currentView = viewName;
  const viewMap = {
    'tickets': { id: 'admin-view-tickets', btn: 'btn-admin-nav-tickets', title: 'Live Tickets & Agent Takeover Console' },
    'rag': { id: 'admin-view-rag', btn: 'btn-admin-nav-rag', title: 'Internal RAG Policy Manager' },
    'analytics': { id: 'admin-view-analytics', btn: 'btn-admin-nav-analytics', title: 'Deflection & CSAT Telemetry' },
    'settings': { id: 'admin-view-settings', btn: 'btn-admin-nav-settings', title: 'Pipeline & Guardrail Settings' }
  };

  Object.values(viewMap).forEach(v => {
    const el = document.getElementById(v.id);
    const btn = document.getElementById(v.btn);
    if (el) el.classList.remove('active-view');
    if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
  });

  const active = viewMap[viewName] || viewMap['tickets'];
  const activeEl = document.getElementById(active.id);
  const activeBtn = document.getElementById(active.btn);
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('admin-current-view-title');

  if (activeEl) activeEl.classList.add('active-view');
  if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = active.title;

  if (viewName === 'tickets') loadAdminTickets();
  if (viewName === 'rag') loadRagStatus();
  if (viewName === 'analytics') loadAuditLogs();
}

// ==========================================================================
// 1. TOP KPI TELEMETRY RIBBON
// ==========================================================================
async function loadTelemetry(silent = false) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/metrics`, {
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;

    const data = await res.json();
    const metrics = data.metrics || {};

    const elTotal = document.getElementById('kpi-total-tickets');
    const elOpen = document.getElementById('kpi-open-tickets');
    const elRate = document.getElementById('kpi-deflection-rate');
    const elCsat = document.getElementById('kpi-avg-csat');
    const elSections = document.getElementById('kpi-indexed-sections');

    if (elTotal) elTotal.textContent = metrics.total_tickets || data.total_queries || '150+';
    if (elOpen) elOpen.textContent = metrics.open_tickets || '4';
    if (elRate) elRate.textContent = `${data.deflection_rate || 88.4}%`;
    if (elCsat) elCsat.textContent = `${data.avg_csat || 4.9} / 5.0`;

    // Fetch chunk count
    const ragRes = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/rag/status`);
    if (ragRes.ok) {
      const ragData = await ragRes.json();
      if (elSections) elSections.textContent = `${ragData.total_chunks || 6} Chunks`;
    }

  } catch (e) {
    if (!silent) console.warn('Telemetry load failed:', e);
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// 2. LIVE TICKET & TAKEOVER CONSOLE
// ==========================================================================
async function loadAdminTickets(silent = false) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/tickets`, {
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;

    const data = await res.json();
    AdminState.tickets = data.tickets || [];

    // Update sidebar badge
    const badge = document.getElementById('admin-sidebar-ticket-count');
    const openCount = AdminState.tickets.filter(t => t.status === 'Open').length;
    if (badge) {
      badge.textContent = openCount;
      badge.style.display = openCount > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
    }

    renderTicketsTable();
  } catch (e) {
    if (!silent) console.warn('Tickets load failed:', e);
  }
}

function filterAdminTickets(filter, btn) {
  AdminState.activeFilter = filter;
  document.querySelectorAll('#admin-view-tickets .chip-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  renderTicketsTable();
}

function renderTicketsTable() {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('admin-tickets-table-body');
  const label = document.getElementById('tickets-count-label');
  if (!tbody) return;

  let list = AdminState.tickets;
  if (AdminState.activeFilter === 'Urgent') {
    list = list.filter(t => t.priority === 'Urgent' || t.priority === 'High');
  } else if (AdminState.activeFilter !== 'all') {
    list = list.filter(t => t.status === AdminState.activeFilter);
  }

  if (label) label.textContent = `Showing ${list.length} of ${AdminState.tickets.length} tickets`;

  if (list.length === 0) {
    tbody.innerHTML = `
      <tr>
        <td colspan="7" style="text-align:center; padding:30px; color:var(--text-dim);">
          No tickets found matching "${AdminState.activeFilter}".
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = '';
  list.forEach(t => {
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    if (AdminState.selectedTicket && AdminState.selectedTicket.id === t.id) {
      tr.className = 'row-selected';
    }

    const pClass = (t.priority || 'medium').toLowerCase();
    const stClass = t.status === 'Resolved' ? 'delivered' : t.status === 'In Progress' ? 'shipped' : 'processing';
    const slaText = t.sla_details ? t.sla_details.label : 'SLA Active';

    tr.innerHTML = `
      <td><strong style="color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-mono);">${t.id}</strong></td>
      <td>
        <div style="font-weight:600; color:var(--text-main);">${escapeHtml(t.customer_name || 'Customer')}</div>
        <div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text-dim);">${escapeHtml(t.customer_email || '')}</div>
      </td>
      <td>
        <div style="font-weight:500; color:#fff;">${escapeHtml(t.subject || 'Inquiry')}</div>
        <div style="font-size:12px; color:var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml((t.query || '').slice(0, 60))}${t.query && t.query.length > 60 ? '...' : ''}</div>
      </td>
      <td><span class="priority-badge priority-${pClass}">${t.priority || 'Medium'}</span></td>
      <td><span class="status-badge badge-${stClass}">${t.status || 'Open'}</span></td>
      <td><span style="font-size:11.5px; font-family:var(--font-mono); color:var(--accent-cyan);">${slaText}</span></td>
      <td style="text-align:right;">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onclick="openTakeoverDrawer('${t.id}')">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-headset text-cyan"></i> Takeover
        </button>
      </td>
    `;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
}

// ==========================================================================
// 3. AGENT TAKEOVER DRAWER
// ==========================================================================
async function openTakeoverDrawer(ticketId) {
  const drawer = document.getElementById('agent-takeover-drawer');
  drawer.classList.add('is-open');

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/tickets/${encodeURIComponent(ticketId)}/State`, {
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load ticket state');

    const data = await res.json();
    const t = data.ticket || data.state;
    AdminState.selectedTicket = t;

    // Populate drawer elements
    document.getElementById('drawer-ticket-id').textContent = t.id;
    document.getElementById('drawer-customer-name').textContent = t.customer_name || 'Customer';
    document.getElementById('drawer-customer-email').textContent = t.customer_email || '';
    document.getElementById('drawer-subject').textContent = t.subject || t.query;

    const pBadge = document.getElementById('drawer-priority-badge');
    const pClass = (t.priority || 'medium').toLowerCase();
    pBadge.textContent = t.priority || 'Medium';
    pBadge.className = `priority-badge priority-${pClass}`;

    const stPill = document.getElementById('drawer-status-pill');
    stPill.textContent = t.status || 'Open';
    stPill.className = `status-badge badge-${t.status === 'Resolved' ? 'delivered' : t.status === 'In Progress' ? 'shipped' : 'processing'}`;

    const slaLabel = document.getElementById('drawer-sla-label');
    if (slaLabel && t.sla_details) {
      slaLabel.textContent = t.sla_details.label || 'SLA Met';
    }

    const stSelect = document.getElementById('drawer-status-select');
    if (stSelect) stSelect.value = t.status || 'Open';

    renderDrawerMessages(t.messages || []);
    renderTicketsTable();

  } catch (e) {
    showToast(e.message, 'error');
  }
}

function closeTakeoverDrawer() {
  document.getElementById('agent-takeover-drawer').classList.remove('is-open');
  AdminState.selectedTicket = null;
  renderTicketsTable();
}

function renderDrawerMessages(messages) {
  const stream = document.getElementById('drawer-messages-stream');
  if (!stream) return;
  stream.innerHTML = '';

  messages.forEach(m => {
    const isStaff = m.sender !== 'Elena Rostova' && m.sender !== 'Customer' && !m.sender.toLowerCase().includes('user');
    const isNote = Boolean(m.is_internal_note);

    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.style.cssText = `
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      background: ${isNote ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)' : isStaff ? 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12)' : 'var(--bg-surface)'};
      border: 1px solid ${isNote ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3)' : isStaff ? 'var(--primary-border)' : 'var(--border-subtle)'};
    `;

    div.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:4px; font-size:11px;">
        <strong style="color:${isNote ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : isStaff ? 'var(--primary-light)' : '#fff'};">
          ${isNote ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i> Staff Note • ' : ''}${escapeHtml(m.sender)}
        </strong>
        <span style="color:var(--text-dim);">${m.timestamp || ''}</span>
      </div>
      <div>${escapeHtml(m.text || '')}</div>
    `;
    stream.appendChild(div);
  });
  stream.scrollTop = stream.scrollHeight;
}

async function generateCopilotReply() {
  if (!AdminState.selectedTicket) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-generate-copilot');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Generating...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/tickets/${AdminState.selectedTicket.id}/suggest-reply`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Copilot drafting failed');

    const data = await res.json();
    const draft = data.suggested_reply || data.draft || '';
    document.getElementById('drawer-reply-text').value = draft;
    showToast('Copilot draft generated');
  } catch (e) {
    showToast(e.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = 'Generate Draft';
  }
}

async function applyMacro(macroId) {
  if (!AdminState.selectedTicket) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/tickets/${AdminState.selectedTicket.id}/apply-macro`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ macro_id: macroId, sender: 'Support Specialist' })
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Macro application failed');

    const data = await res.json();
    document.getElementById('drawer-reply-text').value = data.applied_text || '';
    showToast('Macro template applied');
  } catch (e) {
    showToast(e.message, 'error');
  }
}

async function sendAgentReply() {
  if (!AdminState.selectedTicket) return;
  const textInput = document.getElementById('drawer-reply-text');
  const text = textInput.value.trim();
  const isNote = document.getElementById('drawer-is-internal-note').checked;
  const newStatus = document.getElementById('drawer-status-select').value;
  if (!text) return;

  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-drawer-send-reply');
  btn.disabled = true;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/tickets/${AdminState.selectedTicket.id}/reply`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({
        sender: 'Support Specialist',
        text: text,
        is_internal_note: isNote,
        status: newStatus
      })
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to post reply');

    textInput.value = '';
    showToast(isNote ? 'Internal note added' : 'Reply sent to customer');

    // Reload ticket details
    await openTakeoverDrawer(AdminState.selectedTicket.id);
    await loadAdminTickets(true);
  } catch (e) {
    showToast(e.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// 4. INTERNAL RAG POLICY MANAGER
// ==========================================================================
async function loadRagStatus() {
  const list = document.getElementById('rag-chunks-list');
  const editor = document.getElementById('rag-policy-editor');
  const pathLabel = document.getElementById('rag-kb-path-label');
  if (!list) return;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/rag/status`, {
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;

    const data = await res.json();
    if (pathLabel) pathLabel.textContent = `Path: ${data.kb_path || 'knowledge_base/company_faq.txt'} (${data.total_chunks} chunks)`;

    // Fetch raw policy text if empty
    if (editor && !editor.value) {
      const polRes = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/admin/rag-upload`, {
        headers: getAuthHeaders()
      });
      if (polRes.ok) {
        const polData = await polRes.json();
        editor.value = polData.content || '';
      }
    }

    // Render chunk preview cards
    const chunks = data.sample_chunks || [
      { id: 'chunk_0', title: '1. RETURN AND EXCHANGE POLICY' },
      { id: 'chunk_1', title: '2. SHIPPING AND DELIVERY' },
      { id: 'chunk_2', title: '3. ORDER MODIFICATION & CANCELLATION' },
      { id: 'chunk_3', title: '4. DAMAGED OR DEFECTIVE ITEMS' },
      { id: 'chunk_4', title: '5. ACCOUNT, BILLING & PROMOTIONS' },
      { id: 'chunk_5', title: '6. CUSTOMER SUPPORT ESCALATION & HOURS' }
    ];

    list.innerHTML = '';
    chunks.forEach((c, idx) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = `
        padding: 10px 12px;
        background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
      `;
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div>
          <strong style="color:#fff; font-size:13px;">${escapeHtml(c.title || c.section || `Section #${idx + 1}`)}</strong>
          <div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-top:2px;">Indexed Vector Chunk #${idx}</div>
        </div>
        <span class="status-badge badge-delivered" style="font-size:10px;">ChromaDB Ready</span>
      `;
      list.appendChild(card);
    });

  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('RAG status failed:', e);
  }
}

function handleRagFileUpload(event) {
  const file = event.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;

  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (e) => {
    document.getElementById('rag-policy-editor').value = e.target.result;
    showToast(`Loaded ${file.name} into editor`);
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
}

async function uploadAndReindexPolicy() {
  const editor = document.getElementById('rag-policy-editor');
  const text = editor.value.trim();
  if (!text) {
    alert('Please enter or paste policy content.');
    return;
  }

  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-reindex-rag');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Re-Indexing in ChromaDB...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/admin/rag-upload`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ content: text })
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Re-indexing failed');

    const data = await res.json();
    showToast(`ChromaDB Re-Indexed: ${data.total_chunks || 6} sections active`);
    await loadRagStatus();
    await loadTelemetry(true);
  } catch (e) {
    showToast(e.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-bolt"></i> Re-Index in ChromaDB';
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// 5. AUDIT LOGS & ANALYTICS
// ==========================================================================
async function loadAuditLogs() {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('audit-log-table-body');
  if (!tbody) return;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${AdminState.backendUrl}/api/metrics`, {
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) return;

    const data = await res.json();
    const audits = data.audit_logs || [];

    if (audits.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; padding:20px; color:var(--text-dim);">No audit logs yet.</td></tr>`;
      return;
    }

    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    audits.slice(0, 10).forEach(a => {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      const isDeflected = (a.status || '').includes('Resolved');
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:12px;">${a.timestamp || 'Recent'}</td>
        <td style="font-weight:500; color:#fff;">${escapeHtml(a.query || '')}</td>
        <td><span class="status-badge ${isDeflected ? 'badge-delivered' : 'badge-processing'}">${a.status}</span></td>
        <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono); color:var(--accent-cyan);">${a.distance != null ? a.distance : '0.42'}</td>
        <td style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:12px;">${escapeHtml(a.matched || 'company_faq.txt')}</td>
      `;
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });

  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Audit logs load failed:', e);
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// TOAST NOTIFICATION UTILITY
// ==========================================================================
function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = 'toast';
  toast.innerHTML = `
    <i class="fa-solid ${type === 'error' ? 'fa-triangle-exclamation text-rose' : 'fa-circle-check text-emerald'}"></i>
    <span>${escapeHtml(message)}</span>
  `;

  container.appendChild(toast);
  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = '0';
    toast.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
  }, 3500);
}

// Utility: Escape HTML
function escapeHtml(str) {
  return String(str || '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}
```

### <a id="jsappjs"></a> `js/app.js`
```javascript
/* ==========================================================================
   OMNIDESK AI — CUSTOMER SUPPORT PORTAL CONTROLLER (app.js)
   Synchronized Desktop-First Two-Window UI (Window 1)
   Features: RAG Chat + Collapsible Sources, Order Tracking,
   My Support Tickets, Visual Claim Inspection, and Live Agent Sync.
   ========================================================================== */

const CustomerState = {
  currentView: 'chat',
  backendUrl: window.location.origin.startsWith('http') && !window.location.port.match(/^(5500|3000|5173)$/)
    ? window.location.origin
    : 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
  activeTicketId: localStorage.getItem('omni_active_ticket_id') || null,
  activeTicketData: null,
  lastKnownMessageCount: 0,
  claimImageBase64: '',
  claimImageMime: 'image/jpeg',
  claimDiagnosis: null,
  pollTimer: null
};

// ==========================================================================
// INITIALIZATION
// ==========================================================================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  checkBackendHealth();
  setupDragAndDrop();

  // Restore active ticket sync if one exists
  if (CustomerState.activeTicketId) {
    updateSyncIndicator(CustomerState.activeTicketId);
    startLiveTicketPolling(CustomerState.activeTicketId);
  }

  // Pre-load default order display
  lookupOrder('ORD-1001', false);
});

// Check Server Health
async function checkBackendHealth() {
  const dot = document.getElementById('sidebar-status-dot');
  const text = document.getElementById('sidebar-status-text');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/health`);
    if (res.ok) {
      if (dot) dot.className = 'pulse-dot';
      if (text) text.textContent = 'Support Live (24/7)';
    } else {
      throw new Error('Non-200');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (dot) dot.className = 'pulse-dot pulse-offline';
    if (text) text.textContent = 'Offline (Reconnecting)';
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// NAVIGATION CONTROLLER
// ==========================================================================
function switchCustomerView(viewName) {
  CustomerState.currentView = viewName;
  const viewMap = {
    'chat': { id: 'view-chat', btn: 'btn-nav-chat', title: 'AI Policy Assistant' },
    'orders': { id: 'view-orders', btn: 'btn-nav-orders', title: 'Customer Order Tracking' },
    'tickets': { id: 'view-tickets', btn: 'btn-nav-tickets', title: 'My Support Tickets' },
    'claim': { id: 'view-claim', btn: 'btn-nav-claim', title: 'Visual Claim Inspection' }
  };

  Object.values(viewMap).forEach(v => {
    const el = document.getElementById(v.id);
    const btn = document.getElementById(v.btn);
    if (el) el.classList.remove('active-view');
    if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
  });

  const active = viewMap[viewName] || viewMap['chat'];
  const activeEl = document.getElementById(active.id);
  const activeBtn = document.getElementById(active.btn);
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('current-view-title');

  if (activeEl) activeEl.classList.add('active-view');
  if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = active.title;

  if (viewName === 'tickets' && CustomerState.activeTicketId) {
    loadTicketDetails(CustomerState.activeTicketId);
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// 1. AI CHAT WORKSPACE & GROUNDED RESPONSES
// ==========================================================================
function sendQuickPrompt(promptText) {
  switchCustomerView('chat');
  const input = document.getElementById('chat-text-input');
  if (input) {
    input.value = promptText;
    document.getElementById('chat-input-form').dispatchEvent(new Event('submit'));
  }
}

function handleTextareaKeydown(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey) {
    event.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('chat-input-form').dispatchEvent(new Event('submit'));
  }
}

function autoResizeTextarea(textarea) {
  textarea.style.height = 'auto';
  textarea.style.height = Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 140) + 'px';
}

async function handleChatSubmit(event) {
  if (event) event.preventDefault();
  const input = document.getElementById('chat-text-input');
  const query = input.value.trim();
  if (!query) return;

  input.value = '';
  autoResizeTextarea(input);

  // Append User Bubble
  appendChatMessage('user', query);

  // Loading Indicator
  const loadingId = 'loading-' + Date.now();
  appendChatMessage('assistant', '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Checking official store policies in ChromaDB...', loadingId);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/chat`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query: query,
        email: 'elena.r@techcorp.io'
      })
    });

    const loadingEl = document.getElementById(loadingId);
    if (loadingEl) loadingEl.remove();

    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`API Error (${res.status})`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    const answer = data.answer || data.response || "No response generated.";
    const sources = data.sources || [];
    const sections = data.sections || [];
    const order = data.order;
    const ticket = data.ticket;

    // Render Assistant Message with Collapsible Verified Sources
    renderAssistantChatReply(answer, sources, sections, order);

    // If query auto-escalated to a human ticket
    if (ticket && ticket.id) {
      handleAutoEscalationTrigger(ticket);
    }

  } catch (err) {
    const loadingEl = document.getElementById(loadingId);
    if (loadingEl) loadingEl.remove();
    appendChatMessage('assistant', `⚠️ Could not complete inquiry: ${err.message}. Please verify the server is running.`);
  }
}

function appendChatMessage(sender, htmlContent, elementId = null) {
  const feed = document.getElementById('chat-feed');
  const row = document.createElement('div');
  row.className = `chat-msg-row ${sender === 'user' ? 'user-msg' : sender === 'agent' ? 'agent-msg' : 'assistant-msg'}`;
  if (elementId) row.id = elementId;

  const avatar = document.createElement('div');
  avatar.className = `avatar-badge ${sender === 'user' ? 'avatar-user' : sender === 'agent' ? 'avatar-agent' : 'avatar-assistant'}`;
  avatar.innerHTML = sender === 'user'
    ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i>'
    : sender === 'agent'
      ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-headset"></i>'
      : '<i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i>';

  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'msg-content-wrapper';

  const label = document.createElement('div');
  label.className = 'msg-sender-label';
  label.textContent = sender === 'user' ? 'You' : sender === 'agent' ? 'OmniDesk Staff • Live Agent' : 'OmniDesk AI • Policy Assistant';

  const bubble = document.createElement('div');
  bubble.className = 'msg-bubble-content';
  bubble.innerHTML = htmlContent;

  wrapper.appendChild(label);
  wrapper.appendChild(bubble);
  row.appendChild(avatar);
  row.appendChild(wrapper);

  feed.appendChild(row);
  feed.scrollTop = feed.scrollHeight;
}

function renderAssistantChatReply(answer, sources, sections, order) {
  const feed = document.getElementById('chat-feed');
  const row = document.createElement('div');
  row.className = 'chat-msg-row assistant-msg';

  const avatar = document.createElement('div');
  avatar.className = 'avatar-badge avatar-assistant';
  avatar.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i>';

  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'msg-content-wrapper';

  const label = document.createElement('div');
  label.className = 'msg-sender-label';
  label.textContent = 'OmniDesk AI • Policy Assistant';

  const bubble = document.createElement('div');
  bubble.className = 'msg-bubble-content';
  bubble.innerHTML = escapeHtml(answer).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');

  // Order Context Card if present
  if (order) {
    const orderBox = document.createElement('div');
    orderBox.className = 'chat-order-card';
    orderBox.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
        <strong><i class="fa-solid fa-box text-cyan"></i> Order #${order.id}</strong>
        <span class="status-badge badge-${(order.status || 'shipped').toLowerCase()}">${order.status}</span>
      </div>
      <div><strong>Items:</strong> ${escapeHtml(order.items || '')}</div>
      <div><strong>Tracking:</strong> <code style="color:var(--accent-cyan);">${order.tracking_number || 'N/A'}</code></div>
    `;
    bubble.appendChild(orderBox);
  }

  // Collapsible Verified Sources Box
  if (sources && sources.length > 0) {
    const sourcesBox = document.createElement('div');
    sourcesBox.className = 'verified-sources-box';

    const sourcesToggle = document.createElement('button');
    sourcesToggle.type = 'button';
    sourcesToggle.className = 'verified-sources-toggle';
    sourcesToggle.innerHTML = `
      <span><i class="fa-solid fa-shield-check"></i> Verified Policy Sources (${sources.length} matched clauses)</span>
      <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-down" id="chevron-${Date.now()}"></i>
    `;

    const sourcesContent = document.createElement('div');
    sourcesContent.className = 'sources-details-content is-hidden';

    let chipsHtml = '';
    (sections.length ? sections : sources).forEach(sec => {
      chipsHtml += `<span class="source-item-chip"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines"></i> ${escapeHtml(sec)}</span>`;
    });
    sourcesContent.innerHTML = chipsHtml;

    sourcesToggle.onclick = () => {
      const isClosed = sourcesContent.classList.contains('is-hidden');
      sourcesContent.classList.toggle('is-hidden');
      sourcesToggle.querySelector('i.fa-chevron-down, i.fa-chevron-up').className = isClosed ? 'fa-solid fa-chevron-up' : 'fa-solid fa-chevron-down';
    };

    sourcesBox.appendChild(sourcesToggle);
    sourcesBox.appendChild(sourcesContent);
    bubble.appendChild(sourcesBox);

    // Update Right Panel Citations
    updateRightPaneCitations(sources, sections);
  }

  wrapper.appendChild(label);
  wrapper.appendChild(bubble);
  row.appendChild(avatar);
  row.appendChild(wrapper);

  feed.appendChild(row);
  feed.scrollTop = feed.scrollHeight;
}

function updateRightPaneCitations(sources, sections) {
  const container = document.getElementById('active-sources-list');
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = '';
  const displayList = sections.length ? sections : sources;
  displayList.slice(0, 3).forEach((item, idx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'source-item-card';
    card.innerHTML = `
      <h4>${escapeHtml(item)}</h4>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:11.5px;">Indexed in ChromaDB vector space. 100% factual policy clause.</p>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function exportChatTranscript() {
  const feed = document.getElementById('chat-feed');
  const text = feed.innerText;
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' });
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = `omnidesk_chat_transcript_${Date.now()}.txt`;
  a.click();
}

function clearChatFeed() {
  const feed = document.getElementById('chat-feed');
  feed.innerHTML = `
    <div class="chat-msg-row assistant-msg">
      <div class="avatar-badge avatar-assistant"><i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i></div>
      <div class="msg-content-wrapper">
        <div class="msg-sender-label">OmniDesk AI • Policy Assistant</div>
        <div class="msg-bubble-content">
          New session started. How can I assist you with your orders, returns, warranty, or delivery today?
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

// ==========================================================================
// 2. ORDER TRACKING PANEL
// ==========================================================================
function quickLookupOrder(orderId) {
  document.getElementById('order-search-input').value = orderId;
  lookupOrder(orderId);
}

async function lookupOrder(explicitId = null, shouldSwitch = true) {
  const idInput = document.getElementById('order-search-input');
  const query = (explicitId || idInput.value).trim();
  if (!query) return;

  if (shouldSwitch) switchCustomerView('orders');

  const container = document.getElementById('order-result-container');
  container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:20px; color:var(--text-muted);"><i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Fetching order details...</div>`;

  try {
    const isEmail = query.includes('@');
    const url = isEmail
      ? `${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/orders?email=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
      : `${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/orders/${encodeURIComponent(query)}`;

    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Order ${query} not found`);

    const data = await res.json();
    const orders = isEmail ? data.orders : [data.order];

    if (!orders || orders.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = `<div class="order-result-card" style="color:var(--accent-rose);"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> No orders found for "${query}".</div>`;
      return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = '';
    orders.forEach(order => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'order-result-card';
      const stClass = (order.status || 'processing').toLowerCase();
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="order-header-row">
          <div>
            <div class="order-id-title">${order.id}</div>
            <span style="color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 12px;">Customer: ${escapeHtml(order.customer_name || 'Valued Customer')} • Date: ${order.order_date || 'Recent'}</span>
          </div>
          <span class="status-badge badge-${stClass}">${order.status}</span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong style="font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted);">Items in Order:</strong>
          <p style="margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-main);">${escapeHtml(order.items || 'Standard Product Package')}</p>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; border-top:1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding-top:12px;">
          <div>
            <span style="color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 12px;">Tracking Number:</span>
            <span style="font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 600; margin-left: 6px;">${order.tracking_number || 'TRK-Pending'}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff;">${order.total || '$0.00'}</div>
        </div>
      `;
      container.appendChild(card);
    });

  } catch (err) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div class="order-result-card" style="color:var(--accent-rose);"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> ${err.message}. Try ORD-1001, ORD-1042, ORD-2024, ORD-5521, or ORD-8841.</div>`;
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// 3. MY SUPPORT TICKETS & BIDIRECTIONAL LIVE SYNC
// ==========================================================================
function lookupCustomerTicket() {
  const input = document.getElementById('cust-ticket-input');
  const val = input.value.trim();
  if (!val) return;
  loadTicketDetails(val);
}

async function loadTicketDetails(ticketId) {
  const box = document.getElementById('cust-ticket-details-box');
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/tickets/${encodeURIComponent(ticketId)}/State`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Ticket ${ticketId} not found`);

    const data = await res.json();
    const t = data.ticket || data.state;
    CustomerState.activeTicketId = t.id;
    CustomerState.activeTicketData = t;
    localStorage.setItem('omni_active_ticket_id', t.id);

    // Update UI elements
    document.getElementById('cust-ticket-display-id').textContent = t.id;
    document.getElementById('cust-ticket-display-subject').textContent = t.subject || t.query;

    const stPill = document.getElementById('cust-ticket-status-pill');
    stPill.textContent = t.status;
    stPill.className = `status-badge badge-${t.status === 'Resolved' ? 'delivered' : t.status === 'In Progress' ? 'shipped' : 'processing'}`;

    const slaPill = document.getElementById('cust-ticket-sla-pill');
    if (t.sla_details) {
      slaPill.textContent = t.sla_details.label || 'SLA Active';
    }

    renderTicketConversationStream(t.messages || []);
    box.classList.remove('is-hidden');

    // Activate live polling
    updateSyncIndicator(t.id);
    startLiveTicketPolling(t.id);

  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  }
}

function renderTicketConversationStream(messages) {
  const stream = document.getElementById('cust-ticket-messages-stream');
  if (!stream) return;
  stream.innerHTML = '';
  CustomerState.lastKnownMessageCount = messages.length;

  messages.forEach(m => {
    const isStaff = m.sender !== 'Valued Customer' && m.sender !== 'Customer' && !m.sender.toLowerCase().includes('elena') && !m.sender.toLowerCase().includes('user');
    const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
    msgDiv.style.cssText = `
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      background: ${isStaff ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.12)' : 'var(--bg-surface)'};
      border: 1px solid ${isStaff ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3)' : 'var(--border-subtle)'};
    `;
    msgDiv.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:4px; font-size:11px; color:var(--text-dim);">
        <strong style="color:${isStaff ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--text-main)'};">${escapeHtml(m.sender)}</strong>
        <span>${m.timestamp || ''}</span>
      </div>
      <div>${escapeHtml(m.text || '')}</div>
    `;
    stream.appendChild(msgDiv);
  });
  stream.scrollTop = stream.scrollHeight;
}

async function sendCustomerTicketReply(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const input = document.getElementById('cust-reply-text');
  const text = input.value.trim();
  if (!text || !CustomerState.activeTicketId) return;

  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-cust-reply');
  btn.disabled = true;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/tickets/${CustomerState.activeTicketId}/reply`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        sender: 'Elena Rostova',
        text: text
      })
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to send reply');

    input.value = '';
    await loadTicketDetails(CustomerState.activeTicketId);
  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// LIVE SYNC POLLER (WINDOW 1 <-> WINDOW 2)
// ==========================================================================
function updateSyncIndicator(ticketId) {
  const syncBadge = document.getElementById('active-ticket-sync-indicator');
  const syncLabel = document.getElementById('sync-ticket-label');
  if (syncBadge && syncLabel) {
    syncBadge.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    syncLabel.textContent = `Live Sync: ${ticketId}`;
  }
}

function startLiveTicketPolling(ticketId) {
  if (CustomerState.pollTimer) clearInterval(CustomerState.pollTimer);

  CustomerState.pollTimer = setInterval(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/tickets/${ticketId}/State`);
      if (!res.ok) return;

      const data = await res.json();
      const t = data.ticket || data.state;
      const messages = t.messages || [];

      // Check if new agent message arrived
      if (messages.length > CustomerState.lastKnownMessageCount) {
        const newMsgs = messages.slice(CustomerState.lastKnownMessageCount);
        CustomerState.lastKnownMessageCount = messages.length;

        newMsgs.forEach(m => {
          if (!m.is_internal_note) {
            // Live toast & chat injection
            const isAgent = m.sender !== 'Elena Rostova' && m.sender !== 'Customer';
            if (isAgent) {
              appendChatMessage('agent', `<strong>[Agent ${escapeHtml(m.sender)}]</strong>: ${escapeHtml(m.text)}`);
              showLiveEscalationAlert(ticketId, m.sender, m.text);
            }
          }
        });

        // If currently in tickets view, re-render stream
        if (CustomerState.currentView === 'tickets') {
          renderTicketConversationStream(messages);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Quiet background poll error
    }
  }, 3000);
}

function showLiveEscalationAlert(ticketId, sender, text) {
  const banner = document.getElementById('chat-escalation-banner');
  const title = document.getElementById('escalation-banner-text');
  const sub = document.getElementById('escalation-banner-sub');
  if (banner && title && sub) {
    banner.classList.remove('is-hidden');
    title.textContent = `New Response from ${sender} (Ticket #${ticketId}):`;
    sub.textContent = text.slice(0, 120) + (text.length > 120 ? '...' : '');
  }
}

function handleAutoEscalationTrigger(ticket) {
  CustomerState.activeTicketId = ticket.id;
  localStorage.setItem('omni_active_ticket_id', ticket.id);
  updateSyncIndicator(ticket.id);
  startLiveTicketPolling(ticket.id);

  const banner = document.getElementById('chat-escalation-banner');
  const title = document.getElementById('escalation-banner-text');
  const sub = document.getElementById('escalation-banner-sub');
  if (banner && title && sub) {
    banner.classList.remove('is-hidden');
    title.textContent = `Support Ticket #${ticket.id} Created:`;
    sub.textContent = `Assigned Priority: ${ticket.priority || 'Urgent'}. Live sync connected with Admin Console.`;
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// 4. VISUAL CLAIM INSPECTION & 1-CLICK TICKET FILING
// ==========================================================================
function setupDragAndDrop() {
  const zone = document.getElementById('claim-drop-zone');
  if (!zone) return;

  ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(name => {
    zone.addEventListener(name, (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      zone.classList.add('drag-over');
    });
  });

  ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(name => {
    zone.addEventListener(name, (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      zone.classList.remove('drag-over');
    });
  });

  zone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
    const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
    if (files && files.length > 0) {
      processClaimFile(files[0]);
    }
  });
}

function handleClaimFileSelect(event) {
  const files = event.target.files;
  if (files && files.length > 0) {
    processClaimFile(files[0]);
  }
}

function processClaimFile(file) {
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (e) => {
    const result = e.target.result;
    CustomerState.claimImageBase64 = result.split(',')[1] || '';
    CustomerState.claimImageMime = file.type || 'image/jpeg';

    const preview = document.getElementById('claim-preview-container');
    const img = document.getElementById('claim-preview-img');
    const name = document.getElementById('claim-preview-filename');

    if (preview && img && name) {
      img.src = result;
      name.textContent = file.name;
      preview.classList.remove('is-hidden');
    }
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function clearClaimAttachment() {
  CustomerState.claimImageBase64 = '';
  document.getElementById('claim-preview-container').classList.add('is-hidden');
  document.getElementById('claim-file-input').value = '';
}

function handleImageAttachment(event) {
  const files = event.target.files;
  if (files && files.length > 0) {
    processClaimFile(files[0]);
    switchCustomerView('claim');
  }
}

async function submitVisualClaim() {
  const desc = document.getElementById('claim-desc-input').value.trim();
  if (!desc) {
    alert('Please enter a brief explanation of the damage or defect.');
    return;
  }

  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-run-vision');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Analyzing with Gemini Vision...';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/analyze-image`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        claim_description: desc,
        image_base64: CustomerState.claimImageBase64,
        mime_type: CustomerState.claimImageMime
      })
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Vision analysis failed');

    const data = await res.json();
    CustomerState.claimDiagnosis = data;

    const diagCard = document.getElementById('claim-diagnosis-card');
    const severityBadge = document.getElementById('diagnosis-severity-badge');
    const textContent = document.getElementById('diagnosis-text-content');

    const severity = data.severity || 'Medium';
    severityBadge.textContent = `${severity} Severity`;
    severityBadge.className = `priority-badge priority-${severity.toLowerCase() === 'high' || severity.toLowerCase() === 'severe' ? 'urgent' : 'medium'}`;

    textContent.innerHTML = `
      <p><strong>Recommendation:</strong> ${escapeHtml(data.recommendation || 'Proceed with manufacturer warranty replacement.')}</p>
      <p style="margin-top:8px;"><strong>Rationale:</strong> ${escapeHtml(data.rationale || data.analysis || 'Physical damage consistent with shipping impact. Covered under Section 4: Damaged or Defective Items.')}</p>
      <p style="margin-top:8px; font-size:12px; color:var(--text-dim);">Estimated Replacement Lead Time: <strong>2 Business Days via Expedited DHL</strong></p>
    `;

    diagCard.classList.remove('is-hidden');
    diagCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });

  } catch (e) {
    alert(`Vision inspection error: ${e.message}`);
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-brain"></i> Inspect Damage with Gemini Vision';
  }
}

async function filePriorityReplacementTicket() {
  const desc = document.getElementById('claim-desc-input').value.trim();
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-file-replacement');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Filing Ticket...';

  try {
    const diag = CustomerState.claimDiagnosis || {};
    const queryPayload = `[Visual Claim Inspection] Damage: ${desc}. Diagnosis: ${diag.recommendation || 'Approved replacement'}. Rationale: ${diag.rationale || 'Warranty verified'}`;

    const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/tickets`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        customer_name: 'Elena Rostova',
        customer_email: 'elena@enterprise.org',
        customer_tier: 'VIP Enterprise',
        priority: 'Urgent',
        subject: 'Warranty Claim: Hardware Replacement Needed',
        query: queryPayload
      })
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Ticket submission failed');

    const data = await res.json();
    const t = data.ticket;
    CustomerState.activeTicketId = t.id;
    localStorage.setItem('omni_active_ticket_id', t.id);

    // Switch to tickets view immediately
    switchCustomerView('tickets');
    document.getElementById('cust-ticket-input').value = t.id;
    await loadTicketDetails(t.id);

    alert(`Priority Replacement Ticket #${t.id} filed successfully! Live agent queue has been notified.`);
  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-box-open"></i> File Priority Replacement Ticket';
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// HUMAN ESCALATION MODAL
// ==========================================================================
function openHumanEscalationModal() {
  document.getElementById('escalation-modal').classList.remove('is-hidden');
}

function closeHumanEscalationModal() {
  document.getElementById('escalation-modal').classList.add('is-hidden');
}

async function handleEscalationModalSubmit(event) {
  event.preventDefault();
  const name = document.getElementById('esc-name').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('esc-email').value.trim();
  const priority = document.getElementById('esc-priority').value;
  const query = document.getElementById('esc-query').value.trim();

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${CustomerState.backendUrl}/api/tickets`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        customer_name: name,
        customer_email: email,
        customer_tier: 'VIP Enterprise',
        priority: priority,
        subject: `Live Escalation: ${query.slice(0, 40)}...`,
        query: query
      })
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to create ticket');

    const data = await res.json();
    const t = data.ticket;

    closeHumanEscalationModal();
    handleAutoEscalationTrigger(t);
    appendChatMessage('assistant', `✅ Ticket <strong>#${t.id}</strong> has been escalated to our human support desk with <strong>${priority}</strong> priority. An agent is reviewing your inquiry.`);

  } catch (e) {
    alert(e.message);
  }
}

// Utility: Escape HTML
function escapeHtml(str) {
  return String(str || '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}
```

```javascript
// Toast Helper
function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
  const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
  if (!container) return;

  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `toast ${type}`;

  let icon = 'fa-circle-info';
  if (type === 'success') icon = 'fa-circle-check';
  if (type === 'error') icon = 'fa-triangle-exclamation';

  toast.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid ${icon}"></i> <span>${message}</span>`;
  container.appendChild(toast);

  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = '0';
    toast.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
    toast.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
  }, 4000);
}

// 2. Animated RAG Pipeline Node Cycling
let currentStep = 0;
const pipelineNodes = ['node-ingest', 'node-embed', 'node-retrieve', 'node-synthesis'];
function cyclePipelineHighlight() {
  pipelineNodes.forEach((nodeId, idx) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(nodeId);
    if (el) {
      if (idx === currentStep) {
        el.classList.add('active-step');
      } else {

    }
  });
  currentStep = (currentStep + 1) % pipelineNodes.length;
}

// 3. Interactive ROI Calculator Logic
function updateRoiCalc() {
  const ticketsSlider = document.getElementById('slider-tickets');
  const costSlider = document.getElementById('slider-cost');
  const deflectionSlider = document.getElementById('slider-deflection');

  if (!ticketsSlider || !costSlider || !deflectionSlider) return;

  const tickets = parseInt(ticketsSlider.value, 10);
  const costPerTicket = parseFloat(costSlider.value);
  const deflectionRate = parseInt(deflectionSlider.value, 10) / 100;

  // Update slider labels
  document.getElementById('val-tickets').textContent = tickets.toLocaleString() + ' / mo';
  document.getElementById('val-cost').textContent = '$' + costPerTicket.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('val-deflection').textContent = Math.round(deflectionRate * 100) + '%';

  // Calculations
  const deflectedTickets = Math.round(tickets * deflectionRate);
  const monthlySavings = deflectedTickets * costPerTicket;
  const annualSavings = Math.round(monthlySavings * 12);
  const agentHoursSaved = Math.round((deflectedTickets * 10) / 60); // 10 mins per ticket avg

  // Render animated or formatted values
  document.getElementById('roi-annual-savings').textContent = '$' + annualSavings.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('roi-monthly-tickets-saved').textContent = deflectedTickets.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('roi-agent-hours-saved').textContent = agentHoursSaved.toLocaleString() + ' hrs';
}

  // Try live backend streaming
  try {
    const backendUrl = localStorage.getItem('omni_backend_url') || (window.location.origin.startsWith('http') && !window.location.port.match(/^(5500|3000|5173)$/) ? window.location.origin : 'http://localhost:8000');
    const res = await fetch(`${backendUrl}/ask/stream`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ query: userText }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000)
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      const reader = res.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');
      let buffer = '';

      while (true) {
        const { value, done } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;

        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const events = buffer.split('\n\n');
        buffer = events.pop();

        for (const raw of events) {
          if (!raw.trim()) continue;
          let eventType = '';
          let dataStr = '';
          for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
            if (line.startsWith('event: ')) eventType = line.replace('event: ', '').trim();
            if (line.startsWith('data: ')) dataStr = line.replace('data: ', '').trim();
          }

          if (dataStr) {
            try {
              const data = JSON.parse(dataStr);
              if (eventType === 'sources') {
                sources = data.sources || [];
              } else if (eventType === 'token') {
                accumulated += data.token;
                botBubble.innerHTML = `<div>${accumulated}</div><span class="typing-cursor"></span>`;
                chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
              }
            } catch (e) {}
          }
        }
      }
      streamSuccess = accumulated.length > 0;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Fall back to local simulator
  }

  if (!streamSuccess) {
    let matched = null;
    const lowerQuery = userText.toLowerCase();

    for (const item of demoKnowledgeFallback) {
      if (item.keywords.some(k => lowerQuery.includes(k))) {
        matched = item;
        break;
      }
    }

    const fullAnswer = matched
      ? matched.answer
      : "I am sorry, but our verified documentation does not cover that specific inquiry. Please contact our human support team at support@company.com.";
    const sourceTag = matched ? matched.source : null;

    // Simulate real-time streaming
    accumulated = '';
    const words = fullAnswer.split(' ');
    for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
      accumulated += (i === 0 ? '' : ' ') + words[i];
      botBubble.innerHTML = `<div>${accumulated}</div><span class="typing-cursor"></span>`;
      chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 22));
    }

    if (sourceTag) {
      sources = [sourceTag];
    }
  }

  // Finalize bot bubble
  let sourceHtml = '';
  if (sources && sources.length > 0) {
    const srcText = sources[0];
    sourceHtml = `
      <div class="verified-source-tag source-tag-mt">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-shield-check"></i>
        <span><strong>Verified Source:</strong> ${srcText.length > 90 ? srcText.substring(0, 90) + '...' : srcText}</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  botBubble.innerHTML = `
    <div>${accumulated}</div>
    ${sourceHtml}
  `;
  chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
}

// 7. Modal Control
function openDemoModal(tier = '') {
  const modal = document.getElementById('demo-modal');
  const title = document.getElementById('modal-title');
  if (tier && title) {
    title.textContent = `Get Started with ${tier}`;
  }
  if (modal) modal.classList.add('open');
}

function closeDemoModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('demo-modal');
  if (modal) modal.classList.remove('open');
}

function handleLeadSubmit(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const name = document.getElementById('lead-name').value;
  closeDemoModal();
  showToast(`Thank you, ${name}! Your sandbox credentials have been generated.`, 'success');
  e.target.reset();
}

function toggleThemeMode() {
  if (window.ClayEngine) {
    window.ClayEngine.toggleMode();
  }
}


```

```text
                    OMNIDESK AI / APEX RETAIL STORE POLICIES & FAQ
================================================================================

1. RETURN AND EXCHANGE POLICY
- 30-Day Return Window: Customers may return eligible products within 30 calendar days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.

2. SHIPPING AND DELIVERY
- Domestic Shipping (USA):
  * Standard Shipping (3-5 business days): Free on orders over $50; flat rate $4.99 for orders under $50.
  * Expedited 2-Day Shipping: $14.99 flat rate.
  * Overnight Delivery: $29.99 flat rate for orders placed before 1:00 PM EST.
- International Shipping: We ship to over 85 countries. International delivery takes between 7 to 14 business days via DHL Express.

- Warranty Claim Process: To initiate a warranty claim, submit your order number, serial number, and a brief description with photos of the issue to support@company.com or via the Support Hub portal. Replacement units are shipped via expedited 2-day delivery once approved.
- Extended Warranty Protection (Apex Care+): Provides 2 additional years of coverage including up to 2 accidental damage incidents per year with a $29 replacement deductible.

5. PAYMENT METHODS, BILLING & PRICE MATCHING
- Accepted Payment Methods: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Klarna / Affirm installment plans (0% APR available for qualified customers).
- Currency & Billing: All transactions are billed in USD unless local currency conversion is selected at checkout.
- 14-Day Price Match Guarantee: If an item you purchased goes on sale or is available at a lower price on an authorized retailer's website within 14 days of purchase, contact support for a refund of the price difference.

6. CUSTOMER SUPPORT ESCALATION & HOURS
- AI Support Hub: Available 24/7/365 with instant answers grounded in our verified knowledge base.
- Live Agent Hours: Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST; Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.
- Escalation Email: support@company.com (Average response time: under 2 hours during business hours).
```

### <a id="problemstatementmd"></a> `problemstatement.md`
```markdown
# Problem Statement: OmniDesk AI — Policy-Grounded Dual-Portal Customer Support System

**Project Name:** OmniDesk AI (`mc-customer-assistant`)

**Architecture:** FastAPI Backend + ChromaDB Vector Engine + Google Gemini 2.5 Flash + Dual-Window Desktop Web UI

**Target Interfaces:** Window 1 — Customer Support Portal (`app.html`) | Window 2 — Admin & Agent Command Center (`admin.html`)

## 1. Executive Summary

Modern e-commerce and SaaS support teams face an operational bottleneck: high volumes of repetitive Tier-1 inquiries (order tracking, return eligibility, refund timelines, and warranty claims) overwhelm human agents, while ungrounded generative AI chatbots introduce severe financial and legal liability by hallucinating company policies.

**OmniDesk AI** solves this by combining a **strictly policy-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine** with a **synchronized Dual-Window Desktop Web Architecture**:

1. **Window 1 — Customer Support Portal (`app.html`):** A clean, desktop-first web interface where customers can ask policy questions grounded in official company documentation, inspect real-time order statuses, submit multimodal damage/warranty claims, and track support tickets.

2. **Window 2 — Admin & Agent Command Center (`admin.html`):** A dedicated operational console for support engineers and administrators to monitor live SLA queues, take over escalated tickets, hot-reload official RAG policy documents without server downtime, and audit system metrics.

## 2. Core Problem Analysis

### 2.1 Industry & Business Problems

1. **AI Hallucination & Policy Liability:** Generic LLM wrappers invent return windows, promise unauthorized refunds, or fabricate shipping guarantees when answering customer queries without deterministic retrieval constraints.

2. **Tier-1 Support Overload:** Up to 70% of incoming support volume consists of repetitive status checks (`ORD-1001` through `ORD-1005`) and standard policy lookups that delay human response times on complex, high-priority escalations.

3. **Disconnected Customer & Agent Workflows:** Customers and support agents often operate in siloed tools. When an AI assistant cannot resolve an issue or detects negative customer sentiment, context is lost during handoff to a human agent.

4. **Manual Visual Claim Triage:** Processing damaged-product returns requires manual photo inspection by support staff before a replacement or refund ticket can be categorized.

### 2.2 Technical Regressions Identified in Current Repository (`mc-customer-assistant`)

A comprehensive audit of the current codebase revealed four critical regressions that shifted the project away from its original specification:

| Subsystem | Original Working Design | Regression Introduced in Current Repo | Operational Impact | 
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | 
| **Internal RAG Policy Engine (`rag_engine.py`)** | `parse_faq_sections()` split `knowledge_base/company_faq.txt` by numbered policy headers (`1. RETURN AND EXCHANGE POLICY` to `6. CUSTOMER SUPPORT ESCALATION & HOURS`), preserving full semantic rules per vector document. | Replaced with naive character slicing (`chunk_text(full_text, chunk_size=400, overlap=80)`), cutting sentences mid-clause and labeling chunks generically as `Policy Clause 1..N`. Added an overly aggressive `_gemini_api_working` circuit breaker that falls back to keyword-seeded random noise vectors on any transient error. | Policy retrieval loses section context, returns fragmented sentences, or fails completely when falling back to synthetic vectors. | 
| **Dual-Window Desktop UI (`app.html` & `admin.html`)** | Clean, full-viewport desktop two-window workflow: `app.html` for Customers and `admin.html` (with built-in `#admin-auth-gate` modal) for Admins, styled with a unified dark glassmorphism desktop layout. | Injected Stitch mobile-first prototypes (`ai_support_assistant_claymorphism/`, `tickets_sla_claymorphism/`, etc.) with `<meta content="mobile_tab" name="shell-type">`, `max-w-md` narrow mobile frames, bottom app docks, and forced page redirects (`window.location.href = 'admin-login.html'`). | UI renders like a cramped mobile app with broken multi-page redirects instead of a synchronized two-window desktop web application. | 
| **Unwanted UI Widgets & Theme Bloat (`js/` & `css/`)** | Clean enterprise support UI with zero visual distractions. | Added `js/kid-assistant.js` (injecting `#sparky-mascot-root` floating cartoon robot, speech bubbles, and Web Audio chimes), `js/clay-theme.js` (synthesized pop sound effects on every click and pastel clay overrides), and conflicting `css/cyberpunk.css` scanlines. | Unprofessional consumer/toy appearance, audio clutter on every click, and severe CSS specificity conflicts across windows. | 
| **Server Routing & Deployment (`server.py`, `start.sh`)** | Single FastAPI ASGI server (`uvicorn main:app`) serving REST APIs and the two desktop windows (`/` -> `app.html`, `/admin` -> `admin.html`). | `start.sh` launches both FastAPI and a legacy Streamlit server (`app.py`) simultaneously; `server.py` mounts `StaticFiles(directory=".")` at `/static` (exposing `.env` and `omnidesk.db`) and routes `/login` to mobile prototype folders. | Deployment port conflicts, exposed database/environment files, and broken navigation between the Customer and Admin windows. | 

## 3. Target System Architecture & Scope

### 3.1 Dual-Window Web UI Specification

The frontend must operate strictly as a responsive, desktop-first **Two-Window Web Application** sharing a single FastAPI + SQLite + ChromaDB backend:

* **Window 1: Customer Portal (`/` or `/app.html`)**

  * **AI Policy & Order Assistant:** Grounded conversational interface with inline order lookup cards, quick-action prompts, and transparent source citations (`Section 1: Return Policy`, etc.).

  * **Order Lookup & Tracking Drawer/View:** Instant status lookup by Order ID (`ORD-1001`–`ORD-1005`) or customer email, displaying fulfillment progress, tracking numbers, and items.

  * **My Support Tickets:** Live view of customer-submitted and AI-escalated tickets with status badges (`Open`, `In Progress`, `Resolved`) and priority levels.

  * **Visual Claim Inspection:** Drag-and-drop image upload (`POST /api/analyze-image`) using Gemini Vision to assess product damage and optionally auto-create a support ticket.

* **Window 2: Admin & Agent Command Center (`/admin` or `/admin.html`)**

  * **Inline Session Auth Gate:** Clean modal authentication (`POST /api/admin/login`) inside `admin.html` without redirecting to mobile prototype pages.

  * **Live Ticket & SLA Queue:** Real-time table of all customer tickets with filtering by status/priority, one-click status transitions (`Open` -> `In Progress` -> `Resolved`), and **Human Agent Takeover** reply composer (`POST /api/tickets/{id}/reply`).

  * **Internal RAG Policy Studio:** Live document editor and uploader (`POST /api/admin/rag-upload`) allowing admins to view, edit, or upload `.txt`/`.md` policy files and immediately re-index ChromaDB by numbered policy section.

  * **Executive KPI & Telemetry Bar:** Real-time metrics (`GET /api/metrics`) tracking Total Tickets, Open/Escalated Queue, AI Resolution Rate, CSAT Score, and Vector DB Chunk Count.

### 3.2 Internal RAG Policy Engine Specification (`rag_engine.py`)

1. **Section-Aware Document Parsing:** Parse `knowledge_base/company_faq.txt` using regex header boundaries (`^\d+\.\s+[A-Z]`) so each numbered company policy section is stored with its exact `section` title and complete semantic rules.

2. **Deterministic Grounding & Thresholding:** Query ChromaDB for the top-$k$ relevant policy sections (`n_results=3`), enforce a cosine/L2 relevance threshold, and instruct Gemini 2.5 Flash via a strict system prompt to answer **exclusively** using retrieved policy clauses and verified SQLite order records.

3. **Automatic Escalation Trigger:** When customer sentiment is frustrated (`angry`, `lawsuit`, `unacceptable`, `human`, `agent`) or when a request requires manual override, automatically create an escalated ticket in SQLite (`database.py`) and surface it immediately in Window 2 (`admin.html`).

## 4. Functional & Non-Functional Requirements

### Functional Requirements

* **FR-01 (Dual-Window Synchronization):** Actions taken in Window 1 (Customer creating a ticket or triggering an AI escalation) must appear in Window 2 (Admin Queue) via API polling/refresh, and Admin replies/status changes in Window 2 must reflect in Window 1.

* **FR-02 (Section-Based Policy RAG):** `ingest_faq()` must index `company_faq.txt` into distinct, titled policy sections and support live hot-reloading via `/api/admin/rag-upload`.

* **FR-03 (Order Context Injection):** Mentioning an Order ID (`ORD-XXXX`) in chat must automatically query SQLite (`get_order()`) and inject structured order metadata into the RAG prompt.

* **FR-04 (Multimodal Damage Triage):** Uploading a product photo must return structured JSON (`damage_detected`, `severity`, `confidence_score`, `recommended_action`) and optionally log a priority ticket.

### Non-Functional & Security Requirements

* **NFR-01 (Static File Isolation):** Never mount the project root `.` via `StaticFiles`. Serve only `/css`, `/js`, and explicit HTML entrypoints (`index.html`, `app.html`, `admin.html`) so `.env` and `omnidesk.db` are never web-accessible.

* **NFR-02 (Zero Toy/Mobile Clutter):** Remove all floating mascots (`kid-assistant.js`), click sound synthesizers (`clay-theme.js`), and mobile-tab prototype directories (`*_claymorphism/`).

* **NFR-03 (Resilient API Fallback):** If `GEMINI_API_KEY` is missing or rate-limited, provide deterministic, section-matched policy responses rather than random noise embeddings.

## 5. Success Metrics & Acceptance Criteria

| Metric / Criterion | Target Threshold | Verification Method | 
| ----- | ----- | ----- | 
| **Policy Grounding Accuracy** | 100% citation of official `company_faq.txt` sections; 0 fabricated return/refund rules | Automated `pytest` suite (`tests/test_api.py`) + manual policy query tests | 
| **Dual-Window Desktop Layout** | Full desktop viewport utilization on both `/app.html` and `/admin.html`; 0 mobile tab docks or mascot overlays | Visual DOM inspection across 1280px–1920px desktop viewports | 
| **End-to-End Ticket Sync Latency** | < 1 second from Customer escalation in Window 1 to visibility in Window 2 Admin Queue | Live dual-window browser verification (`POST /api/chat` -> `GET /api/tickets`) | 
| **Security & Static Isolation** | `GET /static/.env` and `GET /static/omnidesk.db` return `404 Not Found` | Security endpoint test in `tests/test_api.py` | 

```
